One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single-minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.
92472.todo: Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.

92473.text:
The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
92473.todo: Collect 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove.

92474.text:
Well hello there, <name>! Want to play a game?

All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! Use your innate ability to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float.

The rules are made up and the points don't matter, but you get bonus points if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah!
92474.todo: Jump from the top of the watchtower in Thendal Grove and use your Walk on Air ability to slow your fall.

92479.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, <name>. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local hunter trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
92479.todo: Read the Scribbled Letter and speak to Tordrin Stemblade in Northshire Abbey.

92481.text: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident mage trainer--Dorii Brightwhisper--left this recall crystal for you. It contains some sort of message for you, so give it a look. Afterwards, you can find Dorii in the structure just behind me.
92481.todo: Examine the Glowing Recall Crystal, then speak with Dorii Brightwhisper in Thendal Grove.

92482.text: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident hunter trainer--Tai'ree Farsight--left this note for you. You can find her just over yonder near the center of the village. Read the note then seek her out.
92482.todo: Read the Scribbled Note and then speak with Tai'ree Farsight in Thendal Grove.

92483.text:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident rogue trainer--Akeri Duskblade--has requested to speak with you. He left this note, so read that first, then seek him out inside the watchtower, here in the village.

He's a shady fellow, but then again, so are you. I think you'll get along well.
92483.todo: Read the Simple Note then speak with Akeri Duskblade within the watchtower in Thendal Grove.

92484.text: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident Shaman trainer--Windshaper Boro--left this recall crystal for you. Please examine it, then speak with Boro just over yonder near the center of the village.
92484.todo: Examine the Humming Recall Crystal then speak with Windshaper Boro in Thendal Grove.

92485.text:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident druid trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.

Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.
92485.todo: Read the Folded Parchment then speak with Xyton Silverwind in Thendal Grove.

92489.text:
The Kirin Tor have long been allies of the Alliance. With the destruction of their city at the hands of the arch demon Archimonde, the once proud city of mages has now become reclusive and distrusting of outsiders.

In recent years they have begun reconstruction efforts to bring the city of Dalaran back to its former glory. However, reports show they are struggling to contain an outbreak of wayward arcane energies.

We must help them disperse these attacks lest we lose one of our most powerful allies.
92489.todo: Slay the Mana Elemental in the City of Dalaran for High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind City.

92514.text:
You've got that "Windshaper" air about you. Something about how I can feel a tiny bit of static on my skin when near someone spirit-touched that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident Windshaper elder, Illaya Amberwind. She's just outside, near the center of town.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
92514.todo: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.

92515.text:
As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs.

Bring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.
92515.todo: Collect 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws in Shen'dar Highlands.

92516.text: A flock of Hippogryph have recently established nesting grounds southeast of Shen'dar Village and they've been wreaking havoc on travelers on the road. I need someone to head down there and thin them out for us.
92516.todo: Slay 8 Hippogryph Youths, 6 Hippogryph Protectors and a Hippogryph Matriarch in the Shen'dar Highlands.

92517.text:
There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.
92517.todo: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.

92519.text:
Apothecary Jorell was supposed to bring us a case of antidotes and elixirs days ago, but we're still empty handed. That fool has probably poisoned himself again by brewing in that poorly-ventilated shack he calls his lab.

If you want to further help our ward, you would be a far more reliable individual for this job.

Follow the road to Go'shek farm, south and a bit west of here. You'll likely find it packed and ready to go, with Jorell either missing or unconcerned with his obligations.
92519.todo: Pick up a case of Packaged Tonics at Jorell's lab in Go'shek Farm and return to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall.

92528.text:
The faithful of Al'Akir grow ever stronger with each eager new recruit like yourself. As you can see, our strength gives form to the storm itself!

Normally I'd send you straight to Skypriest Aanders for assessment, but he is occupied at present receiving a guest at the inn on the north side of town. Please avoid that place for now. An unshaven recruit like yourself in the presence of such a guest would be inappropriate.

For now, just don't get in anyone's way.
92528.todo: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.

92529.text:
It gladdens my heart that you wish to serve Al'Akir. Our current trials as a people stem from our own complacency. We grew prideful and took the bounty of the winds for granted. The stagnation that followed is the reason the spirits of the wind abandoned us.

Only through acts of contrition may we feel the wind's caress once more. If you seek the fellowship of like-minded shen'dorei, go to Falaath Village and find Missionary Jasaan there. I will mark you so that the faithful will know you as a recruit.
92529.todo: Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.

92532.text:
While you were gone our warrior trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.

Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.
92532.todo: Read the Crumpled Note you've been given, then seek out Blademaster Ren inside the Thendal Village watchtower.

92544.text:
A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.

I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.
92544.todo: Slay 6 Al'Aketh Brutes, 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes, and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove.

92550.text:
Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.
92550.todo: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.

92551.text:
I overheard you might be going to Falaath Village? While you are there, please keep an eye out for our stolen supply caches.

The Al'Aketh have been raiding our supply caravans carrying various goods such as food and windstones to and from the lowlands for months. They've been blaming the bandits, of course, but we all know that it all ends up in the same place. If there's any of that stuff left in Falaath, it would be a huge help if you could recover it.
92551.todo: Collect 10 packs of Stolen Shen'dar Supplies from Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands.

92553.text:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?
92553.todo: Collect 3 Small Eggs and 8 Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.

92579.text:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, <name>.
92579.todo: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.

92595.text:
<Illaya smiles warmly at you.>

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Do you find this surprising? Even those who have not trained as a Shaman may possess the gift.

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92595.todo: Listen to what Illaya Amberwind has to say.

92596.text:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.

Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92596.todo: Have a seat and speak with Rathiril Sunlance.

92597.text:
Here in the elemental plane, we derive much of our arcane strength from ley lines that still run through the ground under our feet. Of late, these ley lines have begun to pierce the surface, giving us more direct and powerful access to these latent arcane energies.

Go to the standing stones to the northeast. There is a ley line there. Tap into your birthright and draw in its energy.
92597.todo: Use your Read Ley Line racial ability at the ley line in Thendal Grove.

92598.text:
As a Windshaper, you have the ability to use the sacred skysight gifted to us by the elemental spirits. Travel to the standing stones to the northeast of the village. Find the elemental convergence there and use your gift.

You'll find that you may draw upon the skysight anywhere, but its boon is much more powerful if you do so in the presence of an elemental convergence. You may at times receive other bits of wisdom from the spirits that are drawn to such places of power, as well.
92598.todo: Use your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove.

92640.text:
Since engaging the cult in the open is not viable, our best chance is going to be to use this opportunity to attack the shrine itself. We can take Lorthuna herself off the board before she can finish her part of this scheme.

It so happens that Valennia has been preparing a strategy for a potential assault on the Shrine for some time now. The only problem is, we will need help.

Speak with Valennia for the details.
92640.todo: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar and follow her instructions.

92642.text:
Valennia only sent one person to help repel a full-scale assault... by the winds.

You don't look like much but I'll take what I can get. We need to inflict as much damage as possible to stop this soon. My people can't hold out much longer.

Go down the hill and disrupt their logistics. Their healers are keeping the attackers coming, if we take them out we might be able to rally and push them back. Any other cultists you kill while you are out there are helpful as well.
92642.todo: Slay 4 Al'Aketh Healers and 8 Al'Aketh Brawlers in the Gustberry Lowlands.

92643.text:
There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.

This defector is hiding at a secluded residence just northwest of Valanaar inside the highlands. I need someone who can discreetly go there, find the traitor, and escort him back to us. This might be a trap, but if this information is as important as this traitor claims, it's worth some risk.
92643.todo: Find the cultist turncoat at the house just inside the highlands northwest of Valanaar.

92644.text: <You reach beneath the still-warm body of the turncoat cultist and recover a small, glowing blue crystal. It appears to be damaged, but it may still be important. High Elder Shadowsong may be interested in this.>
92644.todo: Deliver the glowing crystal to Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

92645.text:
This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.

I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, <class>.
92645.todo: Slay Commander Belguilos in the Gustberry Lowlands.

92646.text:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Ayessa and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, <class>.
92646.todo: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.

92679.text:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The Skyborne man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
92679.todo: Listen to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard.

92682.text:
Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.

Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.

Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me.

Let's see what you've got in a fight.
92682.todo: Gather 10 Ripe Stormapples and slay 5 Hungry Bandits at the Windfield Orchard.

92683.text:
I'm sure you've noticed the giant flutterflies out in the outer fields near the orchard? They are pleasant to look at, but they also have other benefits; namely their wing dust. It can be a mess, but if you can gather it up in large amounts, it has useful household applications.

Take this Flutterfly Swatter and give the big bugs a good swat for me. They'll usually just get scared and flee, but sometimes they'll take some offense. Either way, they'll give their rumps a shake and drop a pile of dust.
92683.todo: Gather 5 Flutterfly Dust from the Flutterflies around the Gustberry Lowlands.

92684.text:
As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?

Take care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well-timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.

Bring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.
92684.todo: Gather 7 Lowlands Galestrider Tenderloins from the Ornery Galestriders found throughout the Gustberry Lowlands.

92685.text:
The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.

Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.
92685.todo: Loot 7 Blood-Stained Bandit Masks from Highwayman Bandits in the Gustberry Lowlands.

92693.text:
You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.

This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.

On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.
92693.todo: Speak with Aamelia Windfield when you are ready to confront the bandit leader.

92698.text:
<You lean in close to try and hear the words coming from beneath the giant construct's armor plates.>

...Function error...

...Question...

...What is....

...Function...

<These fragmented words and phrases seem to just repeat. Maybe someone nearby knows more about this construct?>
92698.todo: Speak with Aamelia Windfield about the Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct.

92699.text:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the High Order here. The current Supreme Magister, Elaadrin Evengale and his people operate out of the lodge on the far southeastern part of Valanaar.

You should also take care, the High Order and Windshapers don't get along very well here. Be careful and give the Windshapers a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.

92700.text:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the Windshapers here. The current Grand Skyseer and her people operate out of the lodge near the center of Valanaar.

You should also be aware, the Windshapers and High Order don't get along very well in these parts. Be careful and give the High Order a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.

92701.text:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, <name>.
92701.todo: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.

92703.text:
I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... thank you, <name>.

If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... our family.

<Aamelia touches her belly gently.>

He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.
92703.todo: Speak with Alvarion Windfield in Valanaar.

92706.text:
Calling all anglers!

A giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!

-- Gazlowe
92706.todo: Bring Bruuz's Dorsal Fin to Gazlowe in Ratchet.

92707.text:
Wrenched from its hulking corpse, the goliath's bracers are massive. Your whole arm, up to the shoulder, can fit through one without touching the sides.

You should bring these back to Hammerfall, as a warning. Drum Fel ought to know what he's up against.
92707.todo: Bring the Goliath's Wristguards to Drum Fel in Hammerfall.

92708.text:
The Windshapers have been hard at work trying to respond to the current crisis on Zephras Isle. We have made several surprising discoveries in our search for the missing wind spirits, and we are developing a plan of action that could help us gain the means to save the island.

We'll need strong young adventurers like yourself for this to work however. Please, if you have a moment, let us speak on this further.
92708.todo: Listen to what Ayessa Dawnsinger has to say.

92709.text: Your highborne lineage shines as clearly in your eyes as the sky above. You are one of us, and it's youths like yourself that will help us save our home. But first, let me tell you more of our mission and plans here on Zephras... and beyond.
92709.todo: Listen to what Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar has to say.

92727.text:
Seeking knowledge is the primary mandate of the High Order, but this work has never been more dangerous than it is now on Zephras.

One of our scholars--Fillion Flamebreeze--was en route to the Shen'dar Highlands to gather data on the windborne magic that congregates in some areas there. Regrettably, he has not returned and we fear that something may have befallen him on the road.

If you can, please locate him for us. He was last seen on the road leading west from Valanaar towards Shen'dar Highlands.
92727.todo: Discover what became of Fillion Flamebreeze.

92741.text:
The Shadowgale Forest is incredibly dangerous and is usually off limits to normal adventurers. In recent months there's been an explosion in the shriekling population and they've started to expand their territory outside the woods, which is a potential problem. I have an interest in the alchemical properties of shriekling talons, so a much-needed culling also presents an opportunity for scholarly gain.

Travel to Shadowgale Forest and hunt the beasts. Bring me as many of their talons as you can.
92741.todo: Travel to Shadowgale Forest and collect 8 Shriekling Talons for Iaadaria Bitterwind in Valanaar.

92742.text:
We must determine the source and nature of the poison corrupting this land. Let us begin with the groundwater under the farms in the area.

Go to the Jansen Stead in the north and the Molsen Farm northwest of here, and collect samples from the wells there.
92742.todo: Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect samples from the wells at the Jansen Stead and the Molsen Farm.

92743.text:
As the strongest centaur clan in all the land, we deserve armaments with ferocity that matches our strength!

Warug needs one most of all. A helm... no, a crown! A conqueror's crown! I heard legends of a fearsome conqueror across the seas. Go to a place they call the Badlands and seek out a crypt there. Return to me only when you have found the crown.

Do this for me, and I will reveal the Magram's greatest strength.
92743.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and return a Conqueror's Crown from the Badlands to Warug in Magram Village.

92744.text:
The corruption affecting Westfall's crops may have seeped into the ocean as well. If the local fish are affected too, it could doom Stormwind to famine.
Collect gills from the murlocs along the shoreline and bring them to me. Murlocs are quite hardy, but their physiology is extremely sensitive to contaminants. Any toxins in the seawater will be readily apparent in the gills you find.
92744.todo: Alba Fairmoon wants you to collect 7 Longshore Murloc Gills along the shoreline of Westfall.

92745.text:
The well samples you collected contain toxic metals! If we do not put an end to this corruption quickly, it will be decades before crops can grow in this soil again.
The Defias have seized the mines of Westfall and use creatures as labor to strip their resources. Disrupt them by slaying their miners in the Jangolode Mine to the north, and the Gold Coast Quarry to the west.
92745.todo: Slay 4 Kobold Diggers in the Jangolode Mine and 6 Riverpaw Miners in the Gold Coast Quarry.

92747.text:
Strange - the poison does not seem to originate from the mines you investigated.

I am told the Deadmines under the town of Moonbrook are the largest, deepest mines of Westfall, but they have been abandoned since the First War. Could the Deadmines be active again?

Please travel to Moonbrook, <name>, and look for evidence of mining or industrial activity. This is the last lead we have!
92747.todo: Collect 8 Suspicious Industrial Supplies from Moonbrook.

92748.text:
The supplies you found point to a massive industrial operation somewhere in the Deadmines. There's no question that this is the source of the toxins plaguing the farmland of Westfall. We need to stop it, quickly.

Whatever's down there will be difficult to destroy. Go to the Dwarven District of Stormwind, and find an engineer who can supply us with some explosives.
92748.todo: Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormwind and find an engineer who can help.

92749.text:
Industrial sabotage? You've got my attention!
We'll start with some dynamite...
92749.todo: Obtain 10 Coarse Dynamite from crafting, trading, or the auction house, then return to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

92750.text:
I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator--why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.
92750.todo: Talk to someone in Stormwind Intelligence about acquiring a remote detonator.

92751.text:
You need something destroyed? Would this have anything to do with your activities in Moonbrook? Don't look surprised. SI:7 stays apprised of all that goes on in Stormwind's lands.

If you're planning to set off an explosion in the caves below Westfall, you'll want to be well outside beforehand. Take this remote detonator--it's a recent prototype from our own engineers.

Oh--and it would be best if you didn't mention my involvement to your elf friend.
92751.todo: Bring the Remote Detonator Kit to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

92752.text: That's it--the bomb's ready to go! Careful with that detonator, now.
92752.todo: Return to Alba Fairmoon in Westfall.

92753.text:
The source of the poison is likely a large metallurgical forge of some kind. Find a way into the Deadmines and locate the forge, then place the explosives.
I will wait for you in the hills behind Moonbrook. Once you return, we can detonate the explosives. Hopefully, with the forge gone, the land can begin to heal.
92753.todo: Find the forge hidden in the Deadmines, and plant the Extra-Destructive Explosives nearby. Then, meet up with Alba Fairmoon at the Deadmines exit.

92754.text:
Our clanmates continue to venture further south, to and beyond the cursed Valley of Bones.

Despite your standing with our clan, I do not trust you enough to share the details of their ventures. They would be boring to you anyway, outsider.

What matters to you is our need for Greater Shadow Protection Potions, in bulk, to ensure their continued survival. Bring some to me, and I will put in a good word for you.
92754.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Greater Shadow Protection Potions to Mirda in the Magram Village in Desolace.

92755.text:
With each passing day, our scavengers return with fewer and fewer armaments from fallen adventurers.

While we cannot use these pieces directly, we do salvage them for scraps. The most magical of the armaments go to me, as I can disenchant them and make use of the mysterious remnants to enchant our weapons, particularly those of our windchasers.

I am in need of Greater Mystic Essences if I am to supply our next raiding party with worthwhile equipment.
92755.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring 3 Greater Mystic Essences to Halea in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.

92812.text:
Long ago, all of the centaur clans in the Desolace agreed to trade in story. Specifically, carved totems that represent an individual or clan's great accomplishments. Despite the endless conflict, all clans continue to honor this tradition, even if trade opportunities between us have become few and far between.

Should you collect any, such as from fallen centaur of other clans, bring them to me. The Gelkis can use more bartering power, and I will inform the Khan of your assistance.

92814.text:
My mate, Halea, is tasked with ensuring our armaments are empowered with appropriate magical energy.

The whole concept of enchanting is far beyond my understanding, but as the centaur whose job is to keep our village well supplied and equipped, I know that Halea is often behind on her duties--to no fault of her own.

I would like to gift her some simple clothes to practice her craft on. I see some adventurers wandering through sandstorms with simple facemasks. Could you get me a few of those?
92814.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a White Bandit Mask to Molkar in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.

92817.text:
Convincing my Gelkis clanmates to put on armor is nigh impossible, despite the numerous losses we have suffered with blades or bolts through the chest.

I have been tasked with designing a vest that offers some reasonable protection, without the supposed 'itchiness' that they complain about. Supplies are scarce, so I dare not waste precious leather on junk.

Outsider, would you bring me a harness fit to a brutish centaur? I would like to learn from your technique.
92817.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a Barbaric Harness to Talra in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.

92818.text:
WE NEED MORE WEAPONS.

MORE. WEAPONS.

HOW ELSE IS THE MAGRAM GOING TO SMASH PUNY GELKIS?

I WANT TO SEE WHAT YOU CAN MAKE, OUTSIDER. BRING ME AXES. BIG, NO, MASSIVE ONES.

HURRY UP.
92818.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 2 Massive Iron Axes to Grolkar in the Magram Village in Desolace.

92819.text: We are almost finished. Use the detonator, and end this.

92834.text:
When the cult began their campaign of violence, the Peacekeepers and Windshapers responded with posturing. I saw this as foolish escalation so I advocated for peaceful dialogue. Yesterday I dispatched my friend Belathaan Brightwish to the Shrine of Akir, hoping to establish that dialogue.

A box just arrived containing Belathaan's tongue, dipped in silver pigment.

It's clear to me now that there is no reasoning with the cult. Kill any cultists you see, and bring me the prayer charms that they carry.
92834.todo: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.

92840.text:
Fillion was sent to the Overlook Standing Stones with a special device used to measure and study the elemental energy there.

Take this--an Index Esoteria--and use it to extract data from the massive windstone formations that form there. Be on your guard however, as the Windshapers are likely to be jealously guarding this site now.

Should any attempt to obstruct you, well... do what you need to do. I have no more patience for their interference.
92840.todo: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it on the Windstone Formations in the area to gather data.

92841.text:
It is time, outsider, for you to learn of our great discovery... but Warug will not be the one to tell it!

Head south to the other end of the village. Look for a big, stinky centaur named Orgrul.

You will know when you get there.
You will know when you see him.
If he thinks you deserve to know, you will know.

And if he doesn't? Well. You can be happy knowing Warug has a new crown.
92841.todo: Improve your reputation with the Magram, and locate Orgrul near the Valley of Bones south of Magram Village.

92844.text:
Some sort of necromantic energy has permeated throughout the Valley of Bones, for reasons we have yet to understand.

Those reasons are also of no importance to us. The magic is ours now, and those who do not fight with blade or mallet are trained in this new magic.

If you think I intend to start you off with a challenging task, think again. For now, go into the Valley of Bones and fetch some bones for me. I am sure you can handle that.
92844.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 426 Gently Cursed Bones to Orgrul south of the Magram Village in Desolace.

92846.text:
Have you noticed the puny centaur stomping about around here? Those are of Gelkis descent.

We Magram have already established a foothold deeper into the canyon. When the Gelkis took notice of our presence here, some among them chose to follow in our footsteps. I know not whether they wish to join us or attempt to overthrow us, but I do know that their clanmates have sentenced them all to exile.

They're lone wolves meddling in powers that do not belong to them. I want them dead.
92846.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and slay Outcast Necromancers within the Valley of Bones.

92847.text:
Outsider, did you notice the weapon that the outcast necromancers held in their hands? We will ensure the Gelkis will not live long enough to master the ways of necromancy, but their methods of channeling caught my interest. They even use those same crystals Warug asked you to steal.

I think we can use this technique to our advantage. Venture back into the valley to recover some wood from the accursed trees, and see if Warug will part with some of his crystals. I will make staves from them.
92847.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Petrified Bark and 3 Imbued Tears back to Orgrul.

92849.text: <Judging by what you've just found, it's very likely that Fillion befell some misfortune here. He may still be nearby, and he might be in need of aid. You notice a cave just to the north of your current location. You should continue searching for him there.>

92850.text:
I am feeling much better already. I have some skill with the arcane arts and we are but a short distance from Valanaar. I can make it on my own. More important than my safety, however, is how close to Valanaar these shrieklings have nested and the danger they pose. If you would be so kind, please head back inside and take the head of that beast!

After it's done, you'll find me back in Valanaar. I need to report to the Supreme Magister what occurred here and the status of my mission.
92850.todo: Slay the Shriekling Matriarch in the Shriekling Den then return its head to Fillion Flamebreeze in Valanaar.

92860.text:
The High Order have done our best to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but that is clearly no longer an option. Their hostility has been clearly demonstrated, and now there are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island. They are clearly gearing up for something and whatever it is can't be good for the people of Zephras.

Report to Valennia Stormfist and inform her that the High Order offers our full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92860.todo: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the High Order is with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.

92867.text:
Our heritage may be crumbling, but this is not our final redoubt. We have more in reserve, and it must remain hidden for its own protection.

Support grows for preserving our remaining sculptures and sacred burial grounds. The rabble that have taken up residence in our old kingdom have no notion of the vengeance coming for them.

Drive back the Boulderfist and Syndicate. They must learn Stromgarde is not merely fist, eagle, and stones.
92867.todo: Defeat the Boulderfist, Syndicate, and Witherbark intruders in Stromgarde Keep and return to Groundskeeper Lomar.

92871.text:
Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have ever been the protectors of Zephras, and we've done our best to lend aid where we can. There are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island, and they are clearly gearing up for something.

Report to Valennia and reiterate to her that the Windshapers offer their full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92871.todo: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the Windshapers are with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.

92872.text:
We eternally guard this tomb and the knowledge of ceremonial rites used to honor these fallen souls.

Now that you've descended three levels below the earth, you take your first steps toward returning to the sunlit world with sacred wisdom.

Each season, we carry some of the dust from this tomb and spread it to the oceans of Azeroth. A symbolic act of renewing cycles.

Take this small satchel. Travel to the cliffs behind Stromgarde Keep and cast it into the sea.
92872.todo: Throw the Pouch of Tomb Dust into The Great Sea and return to Caretaker Alaric in the Stromgarde Keep crypt.

92873.text:
We already know these crystals are capable of more than sundering the ground--the Gelkis have proven that they can be twisted for necromantic power. Do you remember the bones I had you collect? I assembled them as best I could just up the hill. There was enough for two workable skeletons.

<Orgrul hands you a newly made staff.>

I will deliver the Necrokhan's staff while you play with your new toy. Return only once you can prove that you know how to use it.
92873.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, then bring 426 Well Cursed Bones from a successful ritual back to Orgrul.

92880.text:
I suspect it will take a bit of time for us to mop up what's left of the attackers, but our chances are far better now. Head back to Valanaar and let them know that we are stable here now.

I can't thank you enough for your help. We'd be in much worse shape without you. I asked for reinforcements and it seems that I got a burgeoning hero instead. I'll take that.

May the four winds bless you, <class>.
92880.todo: Bring Yorna's Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.

92881.text:
The attacks on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.
92881.todo: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

92893.text:
As you tread further into the Valley of Bones, you will find Gelkis wanderers that dared to enter our territory. I instructed they be kept alive so they could feed the bone worms burrowing about, but they seem uninterested in their prey being alive.

This task is simple. Find the prisoners, then snuff out their life. Don't give them a brief glimmer of hope for freedom.
92893.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and slay 5 Gelkis Captives scattered around the Valley of Bones. Return to Orgrul after the task is complete.

92894.text:
I can see the excitement in your eyes, outsider. Do you grasp the potential of necromancy yet?

Of course you do. And that is why I am ordering you to hone your skills further.

As you venture deeper into the Valley of Bones, you will see the remains of failed attempts at raising the dead. Gelkis attempts, no doubt. Hardly able to claw out from the dirt. Funny, were it not so pathetic.

I have imbued your staff with greater power. Use this to grow our army, and crush the ones that fight back!
92894.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and use the Enhanced Necromancy Staff to fully raise undead that are struggling to emerge throughout the Valley of Bones. Return to Orgrul once the Magram army has grown.

92909.text:
Oh no... I'm in for it now!

I heard about the harvesters terrorizing the fields of Westfall, so I traveled all the way from Ironforge to see if I could recalibrate them. But they're far more aggressive than my calculations anticipated, and they chased me into this stable!

If I had some isosprings and gyrostabilizers from the harvesters, I could build a device to cover my escape. Could you gather the parts for me?
92909.todo: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 14 Golem Isosprings and 5 Harvester Gyrostabilizers.

92910.text: The part you managed to salvage from the harvester appears mostly intact. Someone interested in harvest golems may want to see it.
92910.todo: Bring the Precessive Autocognition Assembly to Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm.

92911.text:
I see... this gives me some insight into what makes those monsters tick. I have an idea how we could override their systems, at least momentarily.

I'll continue tinkering with the assembly you brought me. In the meantime, could you scrounge up some parts for the device?
92911.todo: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 8 Golem Isosprings, 4 Copper Modulators, and a Crude Scope.

92947.text:
Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the the bulk of our forces in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, <class>.
92947.todo: Slay 7 Al'Aketh Guardians, 7 Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and 7 Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.

93034.text:
One of our scouts returned to the village while you were away, with news that confirmed my fears.

The Magram are up to something, <name>. It is not good.

The Valley of Bones far to the east is a cursed land that few centaur dared to enter and fewer still ever return home. Our enemy has found something there, something evil, and we need to learn what it is.

Seek out the scout Nerlokh at the southern entrance, but you may have to prove yourself further to the Gelkis.
93034.todo: Improve your reputation with the Gelkis, and locate Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones far east of Gelkis Village.

93035.text:
You need not peer far to see the undead shambling about ahead of us, but have you noticed something unusual about them?

They walk on two legs, not four! These skeletons are not even our fallen kin. The Magram must be defiling the bodies of those who died long before the Desolace was our domain. I cannot imagine how they justified turning their backs on Mother Theradras and took to desecrating corpses that have rested here for centuries.

Put the undead to rest, <name>.
93035.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan and slay 6 Undead Ravagers, then return to Nerlokh at the southern entrance to Valley of Bones.

93036.text:
You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. They like to play at being a normal religious order and send non-threatening emissaries around to recruit. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but it's obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer.

You are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village.
93036.todo: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.

93037.text:
While I waited for your arrival, I peered a bit further between the arches and noticed something I need you to confirm for me.

I cannot bear saying it aloud. Not until my suspicions have been proven true.

<name>, while you are getting your bearings in the valley, slay some of the necromancers that look weaker than the others. Tear off their ritual garb, carefully, and bring it to me. I must know whether I am of clear mind and vision.
93037.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring 1 Necromantic Garb to Nerlokh at the entrance of the Valley of Bones.

93041.text:
This discovery is devastating for our clan, but it is in our best interest to keep this only to those who need to know. Uthek is one such person who needs to be aware of what is going on here. I suspect she will know how to proceed.

Take this to show her. For good measure, we should also bring evidence of the necromancy itself to her. Find a skull that looks recently cursed. I suspect they may be hoarding them in the maws of one of the goliath's skeletons.
93041.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring an Accursed Skull and Gelkis Necromantic Garb to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.

93044.text:
When you return to Nerlokh in the Valley of Bones, it will not be empty-handed.

Go inside the cave at the heart of our village and seek out Mulara. Ask for Tears of Theradras on my behalf. Our supply is low, but it is our best hope against the Magram's foul necromancy!

I will prepare a ritual. We will create a weapon to disrupt their spells.
93044.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring Tears of Theradras back to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.

93045.text:
I have placed the skull you provided alongside several bones I found while awaiting your return. Immediately I saw a sickly light spread from the skull and claim those old bones as its own. I see now why the call of necromancy is so hard to resist.

Do you remember this crystal? It is draenethyst. I know little of its potential, but I believe it can channel Theradras' power. With it, perhaps you can dispel the curse.

The ritual site can be found by the pond just east of the village.
93045.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and dispel the necromantic curse present on the Accursed Skull. Once successful, report back to Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones.

93058.text:
There was a brief battle between a few of the necromancers just around the hill, and I used that to take a closer look inside.

<name>, not all of our recent losses were defectors. There are Gelkis being held captive further in the valley! I was not able to investigate their situation because a hulking Magram brute started charging my direction. I consider myself fortunate he lost interest quickly.

You must go back into the Valley of Bones and free them. The Gelkis stand together.
93058.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis clan, and rescue 5 Gelkis Captives within the Valley of Bones. Return to Nerlokh near the entrance when you are done.

93062.text:
About this staff of yours. I recognize it as one of Uthek's, and you mentioned it was constructed with Theradras' Tears, augmented with a Draenethyst Crystal, and that it can dispel dark magic?

I noticed that there are skeletons stuck just underneath the rocky soil further into the valley. I believe these are failed summons from the Outcast Necromancers, doomed perhaps forever to an existence smothered in dirt.

Laying them to rest again would be good for our cause, and their spirits.
93062.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and dispel the curses from 8 failed summons throughout the Valley of Bones.

93065.text: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.
93065.todo: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.

93066.text:
On the other side of the valley, we have established a small foothold to prepare to march into the forest nearby. Before you head straight there, I want you to deal with a recent Bristleback intrusion along the way. They seem to have arrived right around the same time we did, but managed to secure an artifact from the nearby temple that has kept us at bay.

This task is simple. Look for the thorns and the pigs. Kill a bunch, indiscriminately. Then report to Hagiak at the camp I mentioned.
93066.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and slay quilboar at Bristleback Retreat. Then report to Hagiak at the Magram Front on the other side of Valley of Bones in Desolace.

93072.text:
There is a second centaur village out here, to the southwest. That one belongs to the Gelkis. You expect me to send you over just to spill some blood, right? Good. That had best be your first thought, else I would cast doubt on your allegiance to the Magram!

What are you waiting for? Go! Kill!
93072.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Magram clan and slay 2 Outcast Scouts, 6 Outcast Marauders, and 8 Outcast Necromancers then return to Hagiak at the Magram Front.

93089.text:
Please extend my thanks to Elaadrin for all that the High Order and your new friends from this "Kirin Tor" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the High Order's plans to leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever arcane solution the High Order finds can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years. If you plan to go with them... well, this mission will be all the stronger for it.

Winds be with you, <name>.
93089.todo: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.

93090.text:
Please extend my thanks to Ayessa for all that the Windshapers and your new friends from this "Earthen Ring" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the plan to take the Windshapers' shamans and leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever solution the Windshapers find can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years.

Winds be with you, <name>.
93090.todo: Speak with Ayessa Dawnsinger when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.

93122.text:
We have all underestimated the power and presence of the Magram clan in this area, but this could prove an advantage.

With so many of their own distracted and their refusal to accept other clans' exiles, who is left to defend the village? What of their Khan?

I need you to go into the valley, deeper than you have gone before, and look around. If the Magram are as well fortified here as they seem, they may have left themselves vulnerable at their village...
93122.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and investigate centaur points of interest within Shen'dralas. Then return to Nerlokh at the entrance of Valley of Bones with your findings.

93125.text:
You! I saw you outside fighting the outcasts. I know not where you come from, but I need your help.

I was lured here by my Gelkis brethren with an assurance of safety. I knew the war in the Desolace was escalating beyond our control, but I never imagined my own people turning to necromancy in a convoluted bid to defect to the Magram clan. When I spoke out against this, they threatened to kill me if I ever stepped hoof outside this tent!

Please help.
93125.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and escort Rokren out of the Outcast Hideaway. Then inform Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones about what happened.

93128.text:
As much as I would like Uthek or Khan Shaka to give the order, I fear our window of opportunity is short. Too short to consult those at Gelkis Village.

I believe with the situation unfolding here at the Valley of Bones that the Magram have left Khan Jehn with minimal defenses. If there was ever a time to attack another clan's Khan, it is now.

But <name>, a Khan is not to be trifled with, least of all Jehn. If you are brave enough to make your move, you must be swift but do not underestimate him.
93128.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and slay Khan Jhen at Magram Village. Once you have succeeded, report to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village in Desolace.

93129.text:
Since you seem overly eager to help our clan, I am sure you would be willing to fetch some supplies while you are over in the Outcast Hideaway.

Felling our foes should be enough motivation for a Magram, but I see no reason why we could not profit from the endeavor, too.

When we have the exiles dealt with, we can secure this place for the Magram and raise an army to bring the other clans to their knees!
93129.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 6 Stolen Supplies back to Hagiak at the Magram Front.

93159.text:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... it's um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?
93159.todo: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him.

93160.text:
I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!

So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!
93160.todo: Gather 8 Shadowgale Acorns in Shadowgale Forest.

93165.text:
The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood.

I have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.
93165.todo: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh cultists in Shadowgale Forest, the Shrine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands.

93172.text:
Most of the elves on this island seem to think that these woods are haunted, and they aren't wrong.

At the old ruins to the northeast, a strange type of ghost-like spirits gather. Some nights, you can almost hear them "singing". It's not like any song I've heard before, but it's definitely a song and it's... just so sad.

I'm not sure why, but I think something terrible happened there at some point, and the spirits are trapped there somehow. If you are feeling brave, maybe you can help set them free?
93172.todo: Destroy 10 Wind Hollows in Shadowgale Forest.

93173.text: <As the roiling currents that hold the Wind Hollow together begin to dissipate, a small metal device tumbles to the ground at your feet. It appears to be some sort of mechanical gadget. The Strange Hermit mentioned he was still missing some equipment. He might be interested in this.>
93173.todo: Return the Rusty Gadget to The Strange Hermit in Shadowgale Forest

93176.text:
Admiring my little menagerie, are you? They are my un-life's work. I've spent countless hours studying them: their anatomy, their diets, even their social rituals.

Do you wish to join me in the hobby? Here, take this package. The notes and materials contained within should get you started. If you lose it, you'll have to purchase another one from me for a small fee.
93176.todo: Use the items contained in the Entomology Starter Kit to find and catch an Arbor Tarantula, Hay Weevil Specimen, and a Flesh Picker.

93188.text:
You have done enough on the front lines. We can handle ourselves.

Tell Orgrul that you have served your purpose. The Magram Front is stronger now, and we have our sights set on the outcast encampment as our next settlement when another fleet of fighters joins the fray.

Well? Get going!
93188.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and report back to Orgrul near the northern entrance to Valley of Bones.

93196.text:
The leader of our clan, Khan Jehn, was slain by a band of outsiders much like you. They were acting on behalf of the Gelkis Clan.

You can stop feigning your surprise. An assault on Magram Village while our attention was elsewhere is a predictable war strategy, especially for the Gelkis.

Do you know why I am showing no rage or remorse, outsider?

<Orgrul hands you a familiar weapon, imbued with even greater power than the last time you held it.>

This is why.
93196.todo: Maintain your reputation with the Magram and perform a necromancy ritual to resurrect Khan Jehn. The ritual site can be found in a tent at the central lake of Magram Village.

93224.text:
It likely comes as no surprise to you that both of the centaur clans are hesitant to accept aid from anyone outside of their clan. This is especially true for folks like you and me - you know, non-centaurs.

One thing we all have in common is an understanding that money is power, and we have learned that the local centaur barter with carved wood. If you bring me a few samples of their designs, I can put in a rush order for similar etchings. Perhaps we can buy ourselves an advantage.
93224.todo: Acquire 5 Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point.

93225.text:
I have noticed that centaur from different clans sometimes gather away from settlements and engage in trade. I have observed this across numerous nights and seemingly with every clan; most importantly I have seen the currency they use: carved totems.

I believe we can turn the tides in our favor with either the Gelkis or the Magram if we deliver a heavy bundle of totems right to them. I have already begun carving some, but I doubt they will be easily fooled without a few authentic ones.
93225.todo: Acquire 5 Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Gurda Wildmane at Ghost Walker Post.

93226.text:
Siding with the Magram would be my choice. There is no question that they are the dominant clan in the present day, regardless of their previous struggles. I have heard reports that they are brutally hostile against the Gelkis.

I sympathize with both warring clans and especially the Gelkis, but this is their war; not ours. We ought to side with the faction that poses the least risk to our cause. I believe that to be the Magram.

Bring this to their quartermaster in Magram Village to the southeast.
93226.todo: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.

93227.text:
At first glance, I would wager that the Gelkis are struggling. Their numbers are far fewer than the Magram, and I rarely hear of them stomping around from our scouts.

Nonetheless, they are one of the dominant clans in the Desolace and survive to this day. They must be doing something right.

If you want to make peace with the Gelkis, take this tote of totems with you to Gelkis Village far to the southwest. Primitive as they may be, they are likely to have a treasurer of some kind.
93227.todo: Bring the Totem Tote to the Gelkis Quartermaster at Gelkis Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Gelkis Clan Centaur.

93317.text:
Are you familiar with Windsong Crawlers? You see, these crabs are native only to Windsong Lake here on Zephras, and they are only able to be harvested a few weeks of the year.

With all of the cult activity of late, I've not been able to get out to the lake to harvest them, and our window is rapidly closing. I'd be appreciative if you could go and gather some for me. They can generally be found along the shorelines around the lake and in rivers.

Do be careful though, they are meaner than they look!
93317.todo: Collect 6 pieces of Windsong Crawler Meat.

93318.text:
By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.

Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.
93318.todo: Kill Vulgara the Insatiable in the Shen'dar Highlands and bring her head to Danarii Bellowveil.

93319.text:
We are relying on windstones more and more for day-to-day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.

We've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.

If you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?
93319.todo: Collect 10 Pilfered Windstones from the Highlands Bandits in the Shen'dar Highlands.

93320.text:
I've just received word that the cult is attacking the pylon watchtower just outside of town! I've sent the few extra peacekeepers we have here to try and break through the enemy back line to relieve the defenders, but any additional help could mean the difference between our people there living or dying.

Please leave immediately for the east watchtower and provide whatever aid you can.

My lieutenant Yorana Windyreed led the relief force. If she still lives she can tell you how best to help.
93320.todo: Report to Yorana Windyreed at the eastern watchtower in the Gustberry Lowlands.

93429.text:
Although they are our kin, the Lost Ones of Fallow Sanctuary have become beings of pure violence and hatred.

There can be no redemption or salvation for them. They are doomed to wander this swamp as mindless, hateful creatures for all their lives.

Their suffering must end. Someone must put them out of their misery. A grisly task, I know, but would you do it to protect those of us who remain?
93429.todo: Slay 10 Lost Ones in the Fallow Sanctuary.

93430.text:
Now they've really done it! As if those wretches weren't already enough to deal with, one of them has stolen my lucky lure!

I was just out fishing this morning, when one came up out of the muck, cut my line, and ran off with it. The thief is almost certainly one of the Lost Ones' own fishermen, hoping to use the lure themselves.

Well, our supply of fish depends on that lure, so I need it back. The Lost Ones fish along the banks east of here. Find that thief, <race>!
93430.todo: Find the Lost One Fisherman who stole Pelluk's lure, and take it back.

93459.text:
The Al'Aketh cult normally gives this forest a wide berth, fearing the rumors that it is haunted... rumors we are happy to maintain. The Druids of my order wish only to live quiet, peaceful lives here in Shadowgale and they threaten that.

Many among us are afraid.

I come with an offer. Fight the cultists for us, and bring us the ears of those you kill. We will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to our secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.
93459.todo: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh in Shadowgale Forest, the Shine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands and return them to Vayn Moonclaw in Shadowgale Forest.

93461.text:
You've got that "High Order" look to you. Those with Highborne ancestry always seem to have a slight twinkle in their eyes that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident High Order elder Rathiril Sunlance. You can find him here in the main lodge, just around the corner from me.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
93461.todo: Speak with Rathiril Sunlance and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.

93464.text:
Allow me to admit something, <name>. While draenethyst is sacred to us, and keeps us sane, none here fully understand it.

I recall a mage who once came to the Harborage, from Desolace. A human by the name of Azore. He feared the power of the draenethyst; said it shouldn't fall into the wrong hands.

At the time, we drove him away to protect what was ours. Lately, however, I find myself wondering what exactly he knew.

I ask that you find this mage, <race>. His knowledge could be of immense value to us.
93464.todo: Find the mage in Desolace who knows about the power of draenethyst.

93465.text:
I suppose it would be more accurate to say I know someone who knows a thing or two about draenethyst.

You see, the warlocks of the Burning Blade have been studying it. It is a substance from beyond the dark portal, so it follows that those involved with darker arts might wish to harness it to their own ends. We cannot allow this, obviously.

The specific warlock you seek is named Gimashi. She can be found atop her tower, which is in a ravine to the southeast. Her notes will have the answers you seek.
93465.todo: Take Gimashi's notes on Draenethyst, and bring them back to Azore Aldamort.

93552.text:
Windstones are a critical resource on Zephras Isle as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on Zephras with us vanished a number of years ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the Windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.

You'll find raw Windstones scattered around the grove. Think you can help me harvest them?
93552.todo: Collect 15 Windstone Clusters from Raw Windstones in Thendal Grove.

93585.text:
Oh thank goodness, someone civilized!

I came here on behalf of the Church of the Holy Light to make contact with the draenei of the Harborage. The Alliance has no foothold here, you see, and a bit of diplomacy with the locals may help us in that regard. The Light welcomes all into its fold, after all!

However, the road past this bridge is crawling with the draenei's more savage kin. If I am to make it to the Harborage safely, I will need protection. Would you aid me, <class>?
93585.todo: Escort Father Tuttle to The Harborage.

93663.text:
The draenei of the Harborage are skilled fishermen, and willing to trawl more dangerous waters than I. We occasionally trade. They give us some of their catch, and I offer some of our extra supplies.

I'd sent a goblin courier to deliver my latest shipment, but he never returned. A crocolisk likely made a meal of him.

More importantly, my business reputation is at stake. That shipment must be found, and delivered to the harborage. Please, find it if you can. Check near the waters along the road.
93663.todo: Find the missing courier, and ensure Dar's shipment is delivered to the Harborage.

93678.text:
I've prepared a transcription of Gimashi's notes on draenethyst. It appears the shards possess some degree of energy, but a pure sphere of the stuff is vastly more powerful. That seems to be what the Burning Blade was after.

Many of Gimashi's notes allude to portals and demonic summoning rituals. Portals to where, or to summon which demons, I cannot say for sure.

While my answers are not definitive, please take these notes back to the swamp with you. I hope you'll understand if I don't come along.
93678.todo: Take Azore's transcribed notes back to Magtoor at the Harborage in Swamp of Sorrows.

93680.text:
The Alliance had an army of mages known as the Kirin Tor. While they were powerful, the demonic Burning Legion proved to be even more so. In one fell swoop, the arch demon Archimonde flattened their city like it was a child's plaything. Those who remained were reduced to merely dispossessed vagabonds.

That is, until they rebuilt Dalaran. And on the Dark Lady's very doorstep, no less!

While in their camps, search for something that can get us into the city unnoticed. I must know more.
93680.todo: Acquire the Dalaran Sewer Key for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.

93735.text:
Historically, the Windshapers have seen to the tending of the magical instruments and devices that were gifted to us by the spirits of the wind. This includes the myriad of magical constructs around the island. Since the spirits left us, only a scant few of these are still functional.

One of the few remaining working constructs in Valanaar has become damaged. One of our artisans was dispatched to help, but he may be in need of aid. Travel to the west end of the city and offer any assistance you can.
93735.todo: Find Riaani Nightwind on the west side of Valanaar.

93736.text:
The paramount concern of the Windshapers is to better understand why the spirits left us, and what we may be able to do to bring them back. One curious fixture of Shadowgale Forest to the north is the presence of a curious form of wind sprite that some call "hollows". We know little of them and why they are there, but we do know that they first started to appear after the spirits of the wind left us.

I need you to go there and disperse them. Gather the remains and bring them back here.
93736.todo: Gather 10 Wind Hollow Essences from Wind Hollows in the Shadowgale Forest.

93737.text:
Oh, hello. Ayessa sent you to assist me? Very well then.

Not sure what an obvious novice like yourself can do, but if you give me a moment to pull my head out of this construct's innards I might have a few ideas of things you can do to help.
93737.todo: Speak with Riaani Nightwind and listen to what he has to say.

93738.text:
Brightwish, eh? So the High Order wanted to remove these components for some reason. But why though?

The High Order has always been meddlesome, constantly wanting to experiment with the wind spirits' magic. They are too bold by a mile, and we've strictly forbidden them from meddling with knowledge under Windshaper purview, but lately they've been testing our patience.

I think you should report what you've learned back to Ayessa Dawnsinger. She can instruct you further on what to do.
93738.todo: Report back to Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.

93739.text:
Azeroth is a large world, and the territory of the Horde is vast. The Undercity, Orgrimmar, and Thunder Bluff all have very unique people and culture.

If you are to be a guest of the Horde here on Azeroth, it would do you good to visit each of our capital cities in turn. Speak with my advisor Nazgrel for directions.
93739.todo: Speak with Nazgrel in Grommash Hold to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with Vol'jin, Cairne Bloodhoof, and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

93740.text:
A number of our Windshaper novices were found dead in the Highlands this morning. We can't be certain but there is a strong chance that the Al'Aketh are responsible. Windshapers trade blood for blood, every time.

Head north and kill any Al'Aketh you encounter. Bring me their windstone prayer charms as proof of the deed. We do not forgive and we do not forget.
93740.todo: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from the corpses of Al'Aketh cultists in the Gustberry Lowlands.

93746.text:
The High Order has been warned of the consequences of meddling with the Windshaper's affairs. I think we need to make an example out of Belathaan and send him back to the High Order with a few bruises and a healthy respect for the boundaries we set.

Belathaan was seen leaving town, traveling north towards the Shrine of Akir. I don't know why he was going there, but confronting him alone on the road is the safest option. Find him, and put a bit of fear into his heart.
93746.todo: Confront Belathaan Brightwish along the road to the Shrine of Akir.

93791.text:
<name>, it is clear your skill with magic is growing and I believe it is time for you to partake in one of the High Order's oldest traditions for young and aspiring mages. It is time for you to craft a spell focus of your own.

Seek out Belann Windwood in Valanaar. He has been crafting staves and wands for the High Order for over a century, so you will be in good hands.
93791.todo: Speak with Belann Windwood in Valanaar.

93797.text:
It is a time-honored tradition for young mages to create their own spell focus when they have shown a certain degree of magical proficiency. This is typically done by gathering a fallen branch from our oldest trees, as they have some lingering traces of elemental wind.

I have found the most ideal ones to be near the wind shrine, just south of Falaath Village. Go and bring me back a large branch and I will teach you about the traditions as we create your spell focus.
93797.todo: Bring a Wind-Infused Bough to Belann Windwood in Valanaar.

93835.text:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Elaadrin and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, <class>.
93835.todo: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with High Priestess Lorthuna.

93836.text:
Muln has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir. Now that the wards that have hidden Zephras from his view are down, we are utterly defenseless. If he chooses to attack us, we stand no chance against him here in his own domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
93836.todo: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

93926.text:
Whatever reason the cult has for attacking the tower, it's not worth losing our people over.

I'd like for you to head to the southwest and check in on that watchtower for us. Find the peacekeepers there and tell them to head back to the village. Holding that tower is not worth the lives it would cost and I'd rather concentrate the defenders we do have here to protect our citizens.

Peacekeeper Vaaniel is in charge; let him know to head back here as quickly as possible. Hurry!
93926.todo: Find Peacekeeper Vaaniel at the western watchtower.

93927.text: <As you inspect the body of the dead peacekeeper, a bloody note falls free of his hands. Picking it up and reading it may give you a clue as to how to proceed from here.>
93927.todo: Collect the note you found near the dead peacekeeper and read it to determine your next steps.

93928.text:
I need a cookie, see?

Nyeah!

93948.text:
Since you are going to Valanaar anyway, please deliver the signet ring you recovered from the tower to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

He will want this back, and more importantly, he will want to learn the fate of his nephew. Talaanis is the High Elder of Zephras Isle and more importantly, he is a good man who is well loved by the people, despite our current hardships. It pains me to think of how he will react to this news. Please express my condolences for his loss.
93948.todo: Deliver the Shadowsong Family Signet to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

93949.text:
We've been bugged.

It's skyhopper season in the lowlands, which means the pests are everywhere. One of the High Order mages reported that one of the insects that they killed had an enchantment of some kind placed upon it. When we inspected it closely it seems to be some sort of listening spell.

We suspect that the cult is using these enchanted insects as spies. Go and exterminate them for us. You won't be able to tell which are enchanted by looking at them, so you'll just have to kill them all.
93949.todo: Kill Skyhoppers in Valanaar until you've eliminated 8 Enchanted Skyhoppers.

93951.text:
The hippogryphs that have taken up residence southwest of the village can be a nuisance, but they also present a rather unique opportunity to obtain their feathers. Many skyborne love to adorn their hair with vibrant plumes and the down feathers of a hippogryph are exceptionally vibrant and, more importantly, silky soft.

If you are heading that way, try and gather as many of the fallen feathers as you can from around their nesting grounds. Do be careful, as wild hippogryph are not tolerant of guests.
93951.todo: Collect 8 Hippogryph Down feathers in the Shen'dar Highlands.

93958.text:
Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... if any of them are left.

I'll stay here and watch your back.
93958.todo: Speak with Valennia Stormfist inside the inner sanctum at the Shrine of Akir.

93963.text:
