Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn.

Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.
93963.todo: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard, High Tinker Mekkatorque, and Tyrande Whisperwind.

94003.text:
I am all that remains of the line of Skybreakers here on Zephras Isle. The rest were murdered by the Al'Aketh.

The only thing that outweighs my sorrow is my shame. My family's ancestral shield--the Skybreaker Bulwark--is now in the hands of a cultist named Zaal Stormshield. Family lore holds no harm may befall a worthy wielder of this shield.

Zaal is not worthy, of that I am sure. Find this man at the Shrine of Akir and reclaim my shield from him. Do this and I will teach you the Skybreaker Defense.
94003.todo: Reclaim the Skybreaker Bulwark from Zaal Stormshield at the Shrine of Akir.

94004.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Elixir of Ogre's Strength, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94004.todo: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

94006.text:
Greetings, <name>. You have progressed in your druidic studies far enough that I think it is time for you to meet one of the great spirits that reside here on Zephras. Urs'endris is a wise and noble spirit, who has taught druids how to take on the ursera shape for generations. Unfortunately his domain has begun to wither and fall into the sky like many other areas of Zephras.

To find him, travel northeast near the waterfall in the shadow of the Shrine of Akir. He should be able to instruct you further.
94006.todo: Speak with Urs'endris near the falls northeast of Valanaar.

94007.text:
Now that you've gained a level of comfort in the wilds of the highlands, I believe it is time for you to seek your very own animal companion.

Go to the port of Valanaar to the southeast, and speak with Quel'ana Quickgale there. He will instruct you in the art of beast taming.
94007.todo: Report to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.

94013.text:
You've returned triumphant from taming two beasts. It's time now for your last trial. The winds of Zephras whisper of greater challenges ahead.

Take this Taming Rod and journey to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, tame a Vuldren Alpha and prove your mastery.

Complete this lesson and you'll be ready to learn the deeper ways of the hunter.
94013.todo: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Vuldren Alpha in the Gustberry Lowlands. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.

94050.text:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than my sister, Quel'dora. She will give you the ability to train your new pet.

Go with the winds, young <class>.
94050.todo: Speak to Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar.

94369.text:
Ansirem has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir now that the wards that have hidden Zephras are down. If the Windlord chooses to attack us, we stand no chance to defend ourselves while we are here in his domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
94369.todo: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

94373.text:
Aye, the time's come, young shaman. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the shaman's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path.

But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.

Bring me two of the necklaces they wear, crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.
94373.todo: Bring 2 Frostmane Bear Pendants to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.

94374.text:
Aye, sapta's a brew forged with magic, bindin' our spirit to the elements. Only a few shaman know the recipe, and it's nae for the weak-willed. Drink it, and ye will see what others can't. Hold true--it's only to be drunk in a sacred place.

Head north to the Spirit Stone, tucked at the end of a hidden path up the mountain. Drink it there... see what the earth has to show ye.
94374.todo: Find the Spirit Stone and drink the Earth Sapta.

94375.text:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Teo Hammerstorm as proof o' our meeting. He will craft a totem for ye, and this pebble will be the heart o' it. As small as it may seem, ye will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest o' things can outlast many others.

Be patient, <name>. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks o' ye. In the end, ye shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect ye.
94375.todo: Bring the Rough Quartz to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.

94411.text:
Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.

I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when it's done.
94411.todo: Slay 6 High Order Apprentices in Shen'dar Highlands.

94413.text:
The recent emergence of the ley lines on the surface of Zephras has been profound for our order. We have more direct and tangible access to the energies that permeate this place and it has increased our understanding of said magic greatly.

The Windshapers, however, view these emergences as scars on the land that must be "healed". This is an affront to our order and is something we simply cannot abide.

Go to the ley line in the forest to the southwest and drive off the Windshapers you find there.
94413.todo: Slay 6 Windshaper Novice Seers in Shen'dar Highlands.

94414.text:
Greetings, young <name>. I oftentimes come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.

They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.

If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.
94414.todo: Speak with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.

94427.text:
A key tenent of being a paladin is the pursuit of divinity. This is not the pursuit of godhood, but merely the pursuit of good itself, for good's sake. We've all arrived at this place due to tragedy of one form or another, and it would be easy to lose that grace that defined us as paladins in life.

Go to the Undercity and seek out Tanis Alderwood in the Trade Quarter. They are in need, and they could benefit greatly from some grace.
94427.todo: Speak to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.

94434.text:
Wait, you want to... help? Why would a paladin want to help a beggar like me?

Well, I suppose that you could be of some assistance.

It's my wife you see. She, well... she's falling apart. I mean that literally. The apothecaries can stitch her back together right as rain, but they are about the Dark Lady's business and none are available to help. If you could perhaps bring me some fresh cloth then I could at least make her a wrapping to hold her together while we wait for the apothecaries.
94434.todo: Bring 10 Linen Cloth to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.

94435.text: I don't know why you'd go out of your way to help me, but I appreciate it. If someone sent you my way, tell them I appreciate them too. You'll always have a friend in Tanis Alderwood, <class>.
94435.todo: Return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.

94436.text:
It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.

The item I just gave you is called the Symbol of Life. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.

Go see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the Forsaken what a true paladin can do.
94436.todo: Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.

94438.text:
Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on Brill. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.

Falgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to Brill. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.

Please, find my friend and help him if you can.
94438.todo: Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.

94440.text:
These Scarlet Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush.

You are clearly an impressive paladin. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.
94440.todo: Retrieve the Scarlet Crusade Attack Plans from the Scarlet Crusaders at Venomweb Vale, and return to Deathguard Billmuth at Tyr's Watch.

94441.text:
Please give my thanks to Danitha Morr and tell her that the rest of the Deathguard will hear about the service that the paladins of Tyr's Watch performed for us.

You have a lot of promise as a paladin, and I am proud to have those like you among the ranks of the Forsaken. Dark Lady watch over you, <name>.
94441.todo: Speak with Danitha Morr in the keep at Bandarion Keep.

94449.text:
It's been long since ye were last tested, <name>. Ye've shown patience, aye -- but now it's time ye learned of chaos... of destruction. Fire's call is loud, and if ye're ready to pay its price, it'll speak to ye.

Seek out Bruegs Kindleborn, far east in the mountains. He dwells in a cave above South Gate Outpost. He'll know if ye're truly ready.
94449.todo: Find Bruegs Kindleborn in Dun Morogh.

94465.text:
Aye, ye've the strength to bear the totem o' fire, lad--but strength alone won't make ye ready.

Beyond the Valley o' Kings, in the crags of Loch Modan, lies a hidden path to one o' our sacred peaks. There, Braldir Ashmantle guards the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame.

Take this torch to him--it shows yer intent. Return it burnin' by the shrine's brazier, and I'll see ye earn the totem proper.
94465.todo: Bring the Torch of the Dormant Flame to Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan.

94466.text:
Bah, ye didn't trek all this way for tales, did ye, <name>? Ye seek the Eternal Flame and the fire totem.

First, ye'll need a sapta to bind yer spirit to the flame.

I'll craft it--but I'll need two things: fire tar from Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north, and a reagent pouch from a Stonesplinter Seer lurkin' in the southern hills. Dangerous work, but worthy of the flame.
94466.todo: Bring 1 Fire Tar and 1 Reagent Pouch to Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan.

94467.text:
The fire sapta's ready, <name>. Now ye face the flame. Use it at the shrine, then climb to the peak. There, ye'll see the spirit--he'll not strike 'til ye do, but he'll know ye see him.

Strike fast, lad. The longer ye wait, the stronger he burns. When he falls, take his glowing embers and place 'em in the brazier. Light the torch and earn the fire's favor.
94467.todo: Defeat the Minor Manifestation of Fire, and place the Glowing Ember in the brazier atop the Shrine of Eternal Flame.

94468.text:
Torch firmly in hand, you turn away from the brazier and look out over Loch Modan. You feel an excitement tugging at your spirit as the wind picks up and forces the flame to dance violently.

You start off down the path back to Dun Morogh in search of Bruegs Kindleborn.
94468.todo: Bring the Torch of Eternal Flame to Bruegs Kindleborn in Dun Morogh.

94472.todo: Speak to Teo Hammerstorm for another Earth Sapta.

94473.todo: Speak to Braldir Ashmantle for another Fire Sapta.

94484.text:
A moment if you will, <name>. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.

With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able, go seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.
94484.todo: Find and speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.

94485.text:
If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.

This moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.

Go and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.

94486.text:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.
94486.todo: Collect 20 feathers from the Shadowgale Shrieklings in Shadowgale Forest.

94487.text:
The Al'Aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm-cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.
94487.todo: Collect 10 Bloodied Heirlooms from Al'Aketh Footsoldiers and Al'Aketh Stormchasers in the Shadowgale Forest.

94488.text:
The reason for cultists' presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed.

One of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists.

Show him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.
94488.todo: Kill Commander Haalien and bring his head to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.

94489.text:
I have finished the poultices. Quickly, take them to the druids in the cave, north just across the clearing. I know my brethren are in much more dire condition than I. They are likely too injured to heal their own wounds. There are so few of us shen'dorei druids that every life is precious.

Before you go, I have a selfish request. My mate, Jorel Windsinger was in dire condition when I left. Please, see to his wounds if he still lives.
94489.todo: Enter the Nightfang Den and heal 7 druids and find Jorel Windsinger in Shadowgale Forest.

94490.text: <Tucked behind one of Haalien's bracers is a note that's been slightly torn and bloodstained in your fight. It looks like it contains useful information about the cultist motivations for the attack on the druid den. Elegael would be interested in this intel.>
94490.todo: Bring the Ripped Missive to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.

94491.text:
It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.

He should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, though the damage has been done.

Please go swiftly, <name>. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.
94491.todo: Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valanaar and tell him what has transpired.

94493.text:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you explain yourself.>

So the message did not get to Valanaar. We are in dire straits indeed then.

<Elegael sighs deeply then looks resolute.>

Then we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
94493.todo: Speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.

94494.text:
Long has it been since ye were last tested, <name>. Ye have shown patience thus far in yer studies, but the time has come for ye to learn about the purity of water.

Seek out Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan. He is along the north western edge o' the lake, south of Stonewrought Dam. Ye will find him there at his burrow hut. Good luck to ye, <name>.
94494.todo: Find Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.

94495.text:
If there's one truth ye need to learn about water, it's this: water means rebirth. It carves stone, cleanses filth, and heals the weary -- but only when it's pure. Taint it, and it'll ruin all it touches.

If ye seek the water sapta, find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands. Her family dwells in a cave beneath the southern falls.

Go on then, don't let the river outrun ye.
94495.todo: Find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.

94497.text:
Ah, so ye've come seekin' the sapta, have ye? Well then, listen close, love. To find understandin' and earn the sapta, ye must seek water in its various forms. As ye gather the samples, keep yer eyes open. Watch the beasts that guard it, the land it nourishes, and how it changes lives.

We'll start simple: fill this skin at the base o' the falls, where the fresh meets the brackish. Go on now, and mind the marsh.
94497.todo: Fill the Empty Brown Waterskin at the bottom of the waterfalls below Hervdana's cave and return it to her in the Wetlands.

94499.text:
Aye, Redridge drinks deep from Lake Everstill, but by the time the waters tumble down Stonewatch Falls, somethin' has seeped in. The murlocs down there are big, twisted brutes. Not like the ones ye find here or in the Loch. Lucky for the townsfolk they keep to the base o' the falls.

Bring a sampling to me. I've a mind to find out if it's magic, venom, or somethin' worse that's taintin' the waters near that old fort.
94499.todo: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at Stonewatch Falls near the Nightcrawler Murlocs and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.

94500.text:
Take this waterskin and journey deep into the emerald shade o' Ashenvale. Astranaar rests cradled by waters untouched by corruption. Ruins litter the bed o' the lake, hinting at a bygone era. Bring back a sample from the lake. Pure, ancient, and possibly enchanted water.

It's the last liquid I need before I send ye back to Norric.

Board the boat in Menethil to Auberdine. It stops in Southshore on the way over.

And mind yerself... the forest's got eyes, and they don't blink.
94500.todo: Fill the Unfilled Blue Waterskin at the waters of Astranaar in Ashenvale and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.

94501.text: Norric will have one more task for ye before rewarding ye with the water totem rites. The vial of water I've given ye is necessary for whatever that task is. Go now and find him. We shall meet again some day.
94501.todo: Bring the Vial of Purest Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.

94502.text:
In Westfall, outside o' Moonbrook lies Stendel's Pond. Once a pure spring, now touched by dark forces. The spirits there 'ave gone silent.

Ye must drink the water sapta, then face the corruption that fouls the waters. Take its bracers and the last drops o' Hervdana's potion, then place 'em on the shrine. That'll call forth a spirit, cleansed and true. Speak with it, learn what ye can.

Bring me proof the deed's done, and I'll grant ye the totem.
94502.todo:
Cleanse the corruption at Stendel's Pond in Westfall.
Return to Norric in Loch Modan when finished.

94503.text: Light erupts as the final word leaves your lips. The hiss of water turning to mist fades into silence, and your senses reel as the corrupt spirits around you unravel, their essence scattered like ash in the wind.
94503.todo: Speak to the Minor Manifestation of Water in Westfall.

94505.text:
Take shard. Take shard and give life.

Give life and understand. Understand water is life... corruption stops life.

You protect and give life with water's power.
94505.todo: Bring the Shard of Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.

94568.text:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.
94568.todo: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong and observe the conversation.

94616.text: Take the water sapta and find the tainted pond water in Westfall, <name>. I have great faith in your abilities.

94638.text:
You have come to me in hopes of learning to take a shape of strength. I have a task for you, though it lies heavy on my heart.

My mate, Ur'endra, has lost herself to madness and has begun to attack her own kin. Without the magic of the winds, many creatures have begun to lose themselves... Ur'endra included. She makes her lair in a cave to the west of here, in the bluffs along the border between the Shen'dar Highlands and the Gustberry Lowlands.

End her suffering and I shall grant you my blessing.
94638.todo: Find and kill Ur'endra in the Shen'dar Highlands.

94773.text: You have done the Light a great service by becoming a shining example to those who travel in these dangerous lands and beyond. Please, accept this lesson as a thanks for all you've done.

94774.text: You've caught the attention of our superiors, <name>. They've asked you to travel to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind as soon as possible. Apparently they feel you've proven yourself already and are prepared to further your training. When you get there, find High Priestess Laurena. She will be able to guide you further. Good luck, and may the Light be with you.
94774.todo: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

94775.text:
Elune bless you, good <race>. I hope your Light finds you and protects you well this day.

One of your priests was here not long ago looking for you. He mentioned you returning to the Cathedral of Light as soon as possible to speak with High Priestess Laurena. It seems you've done well to garner such attention. I wouldn't spend too much time here--your people have need of you.
94775.todo: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

94776.text:
Time's come for you to head to Stormwind, <name>. High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light wants to speak to you. Gotta be somethin' really good or really bad for the High Priestess to want you there personally, but I'm guessin' you've only done well for yourself and it's a good thing that she wants to speak to ya.

But don't waste too much time 'round here. I'd head there as soon as you can.
94776.todo: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

94777.text:
Just a short time ago, one of your priests was here looking for you, <race>. He said that if I were to see you, I should direct you towards the Cathedral of Light. He said it was very important, but I would not be overly concerned if I were you. His demeanor seemed positive... as though it were good news. I wouldn't take too long in making my way there if I were you.

Elune be with you, good <race>.
94777.todo: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

94778.text: You're needed in Stormwind, <name>. The High Priestess there, Laurena, says it's time for you to prove you're worthy of the next level of your training. Don't waste too much time finding your way there. You can find her in the Cathedral of Light in the center of the city. Give her my regards, and prove how worthy you are of such a calling. The Light be with you, <name>.
94778.todo: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

94779.text:
Praise be to Elune, and to your Light, <name>.

About this time, many of our order learn abilities reflecting their faith in Elune. If knowledge serves me, I believe the same holds true for your order also.

When your business in Darnassus is complete, I would seek out one of your High Priestesses for further training.
94779.todo: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

94789.text:
The winds o' Azeroth greet ye, and soon ye'll stand among some o' our mightiest kin. I'm proud to see how far ye've come--your future looks bright indeed.

The element o' air's a tricky one to master, but I've faith your skill will see ye through any challenge.

Make your way north into Arathi Highlands. In its northern hills, you'll find Veyric Thundervein. He'll teach ye more.
94789.todo: Find Veyric Thundervein in Arathi Highlands.

94792.text:
Many hunters prefer to travel with animal companions. With a beast at your side, you will find that you can survive even the most dangerous of circumstances. As they say, everything is easier with a friend. However, obtaining an animal companion is something that must be done with care. The balance of nature is delicate, and must always be respected.

Take this Taming Rod with you to the forest. With it, you will be able to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice your skills as a hunter.
94792.todo: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Rockhide Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.

94793.text:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than Isaac Chan, a lifelong woodsman. He will give you the ability to train your new pet.

Go with the winds, young <class>.
94793.todo: Speak to Isaac Chan in Goldshire.

94817.text: You took your time arriving, <name>. But you can be excused given your dedicated service to the Light. Please pay close attention to this lesson.

94818.text:
Continue your service to the Light and you will become a great <class>, <name>. Maintain your vigilance and dedication!

You are ready for your next lesson in service.

94819.text: <name>, your High Priestess Mims would have an audience with you in Ironforge. Make haste, my clever friend, your next test quickly approaches. Although I wish I could bear witness to your race's own special rites, my place is here. But may the Light go with you in your travels. Mims should still be in the Mystic Ward once you reach the city. She will be waiting.
94819.todo: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

94820.text:
Your race is so very clever, <name>. We are proud to call you allies. And as each day's sun sets, you and your kin grow closer to reclaiming your city, but with the burden of keeping your families safe in exile. That yearning for home must weigh heavily on you.

Word came from Ironforge just recently. It asked that you return there and speak to High Priestess Mims in the Mystic Ward. I would not keep her waiting. May Elune guide your travels.
94820.todo: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

94821.text:
A priest recently visited our halls seeking you out, young <race>. He said that he was on a mission to find you and that you should return to the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge as soon as possible. When you arrive, seek out High Priestess Mims--she will tell you more.

The Light be with you, <name>.
94821.todo: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

94822.text: You've caught the attention of our superiors, <name>. They've asked you to travel to the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge as soon as possible. Apparently they feel you've proven yourself already and are prepared to further your training. When you get there, find High Priestess Mims. She will be able to guide you further. Good luck, and may the Light be with you.
94822.todo: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

94823.text:
Elune bless you, good <race>. I hope your Light finds you and protects you well this day.

One of your priests was here not long ago looking for you. He mentioned you returning to the Hall of Mysteries as soon as possible to speak with High Priestess Mims. It seems you've done well to garner such attention. I wouldn't spend too much time here--your people have need of you.
94823.todo: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

94824.text:
Time's come for you to head to Ironforge, <name>. High Priestess Mims in the Hall of Mysteries commands you to come speak with her. Gotta be somethin' really good or really bad for the High Priestess to want you there personally, but I'm guessin' you've only done well for yourself and it's a good thing that she wants to speak to ya.

But don't waste too much time 'round here. I'd head there as soon as you can.
94824.todo: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

94825.text:
Just a short time ago, one of your priests was here looking for you, <race>. He said that if I were to see you, I should direct you towards the Hall of Mysteries. He said it was very important, but I would not be overly concerned if I were you. His demeanor seemed positive... as though it were good news. I wouldn't take too long in making my way there if I were you.

Elune be with you, good <race>.
94825.todo: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

94826.text:
Praise be to Elune, and to your Light, <name>.

About this time, many of our order learn abilities reflecting their faith in Elune. If knowledge serves me, I believe the same holds true for your order also.

When your business in Darnassus is complete, I would seek out your High Priestess for further training.
94826.todo: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

94863.text:
You've already mastered taming a boar. Now it's time for the next lesson. The forest holds fiercer companions, and with care, you can earn their trust.

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Gray Forest Wolf. Remember, nature's balance must be respected. Prove your skill as a hunter once more.
94863.todo: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Gray Forest Wolf. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.

94864.text:
You've proven yourself by taming a boar and a wolf. Now it's time for your final challenge. Elwynn's balance depends on respect and skill. Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Young Forest Bear. Show that you can earn the trust of even the mightiest companion.

Completing this lesson will deepen your attunement to beasts.
94864.todo: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Young Forest Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.

94872.text:
The fierce Magram are undoubtedly winning the war of territories at the moment. While we can all be thankful the clashes haven't erupted too frequently throughout the desert, every day their village just to the east grows a little bigger; their soldiers a little bolder.

I worry gravely about the consequences of an unchecked Magram clan, but I cannot deny their potential as an ally.

If you wish to earn their trust, offer this sack of totems to their quartermaster, but be careful.
94872.todo: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.

94873.text:
Either dominant centaur clan is likely to pose a good ally, but I ought to offer a word of caution regarding the Gelkis.

I have trustworthy intel that suggests, between the Magram and the Gelkis, the latter are very much on the losing side. This may work to our advantage--desperation may push the isolated clan into opening up to outside help.

I have prepared a tote of totems for you to take to their quartermaster, assuming they have one, in Gelkis Village. This may work in our favor.
94873.todo: Bring the Totem Tote to the Gelkis Quartermaster at Gelkis Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Gelkis Clan Centaur.

94896.text:
You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.

<Ealaane gestures to the other refugees.>

We've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.
94896.todo: Collect 8 Abandoned Belongings from the ruins of Ban'aethal.

94897.text:
If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.

Please, if you find him, bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.
94897.todo: Find Resaan in the Ruins of Ban'aethal.

94911.text:
Greetings, young <race>. I can see that you have much promise in the druidic arts. There is one who you may want to speak with in the city of Thunder Bluff by the name of Turak Runetotem. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, Moonglade.

You will be welcomed there, and the druids of the circle will impart their knowledge upon you.

As your people would say--go with the wind's blessing, young one. I wish you good fortune in your adventures.
94911.todo: Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

94912.text:
Greetings, young <class>.

Have you heard of the Cenarion Circle? I'd expect not. They are an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts, much like yourself. In the city of Stormwind you'll find a night elf by the name of Sheldras Moontree. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, a place called Moonglade.

Go now. You have much to learn if you wish to save your home.
94912.todo: Speak with Sheldras Moontree in Stormwind.

94913.text:
All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.

As for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.
94913.todo: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

94914.text:
All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.

As for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.
94914.todo: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

94946.text:
I had intended to be the first of us to step foot onto Azeroth, but recent events with the cult have changed my plans. As a result, I will be remaining here in Valanaar for a time. Fret not though, we have several mages awaiting our people's arrival in Dalaran. I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we set our affairs in order here. We will call upon agents such as yourself when you are needed.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.
94946.todo: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Dalaran City and speak with Danaaris Stargale when you arrive.

94947.text:
It's a big world down here, and we need our people to start branching out to explore it. That's where you come in.

The Kirin Tor is a member of an "Alliance" of like-minded nations. The de-facto heart of this alliance is the city of Stormwind to the south. Elaadrin has asked me to find someone to travel to Stormwind and meet with the regent lord there, a human named Bolvar Fordragon.

When you are ready, the Kirin Tor mages have set up a special portal for the High Order to use to access Stormwind.
94947.todo: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind and report to Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.

94978.text:
Every hunter begins by learning the bond between beast and master. This is your first challenge. In time, you'll tame creatures from every corner of the world, but for now, start with our rivers and lakes on Zephras.

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Windsong Crawler.

Show that you can earn its trust, and begin your path toward true mastery.
94978.todo:
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Windsong Crawler found near bodies of water.
Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.

94979.text:
You've proven you can tame the river's crawler. Now it's time to test your skill on open ground. The plains of Zephras echo with the cries of the galestrider, a proud, winged hunter that runs like the wind.

Take this Taming Rod and seek one out. Travel to the lowlands and earn its trust.

Show you're ready for the trials yet to come.
94979.todo:
Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ornery Galestrider in the Gustberry Lowlands.
Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.

95034.text:
I think you should know that it wasn't actually the Gnolls who attacked us on the road.

We were actually attacked by a giant, wolf-like creature that I now know as a "worgen". It dispatched our guards and came for me, but Banon threw himself in its path. I managed to get a spell off which startled the creature, causing it to flee, but Banon was already badly bitten. He insisted I leave him there but I refused.

We were limping back here when the gnolls found us. What came next was terrifying...
95034.todo: Speak with Lumina Windsinger in the Sepulcher.

95036.text:
Trevan tells me that the worgen are a major threat to the citizens of Silverpine Forest. Despite their strength and resilience they can be killed, but there is one in particular that just doesn't ever seem to stay dead due to unknown magic.

That's the one that attacked us. He is known as Old Fire-Eye and he is the biggest and meanest of their kind. To put him down, we'll need a special kind of weapon.

Speak with Trevan and he will supply you with a list of what is needed to forge such a weapon.
95036.todo: Speak with Trevan Rol in the Sepulcher and bring him the materials he requires.

95041.text:
Before we fled Gnomeregan, I made a hard copy of my family's archives. Arcanotechnical field equations, Second War submarine hull designs, Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe... our greatest accomplishments are in those files.

It wasn't until we reached Ironforge that I found a hole in my pack! Several punch cards are gone, and without them the data's too scrambled to recover.

The cards must be buried in the snow, somewhere outside Gnomeregan. Could you find them? I know it's a long shot...
95041.todo: Collect 7 Gnomeregan Archival Data cards from around Gnomeregan, then deliver them to Jemma Quikswitch in Ironforge.

95042.text:
A Forsaken paladin... here in Ashenvale? Amusing.

So you seek a Kor Gem? Unsurprising as these are sometimes employed to empower magical weapons and implements by the paladins of the Alliance. Why should a fallen paladin like you be any different?

If you truly desire one of the gems, then you must head north to the ruins known as Blackfathom Deeps. The naga who still use the gems are down below. Do not go alone, <class>.
95042.todo: Bring a Kor Gem to Ulric Frostveil in Ashenvale.

95065.text:
What a view... Best an old man can ask for.

The fish sure are bitin' now, though I'm down to my last bait. I don't suppose you have any spare fishing supplies on you? Of course not, forgive me. I get so excited at the thought of casting another line it didn't dawn on me I may be one of the few carrying supplies everywhere I go.

Would you be able to help refresh my stock? Catherine Leland has an assortment of fishing goods just west of the Trade District along the canals. Tell her old Gray sent you.
95065.todo: Bring 1 Shiny Bauble and 3 Nightcrawlers to Gilbert Gray at the harbor in Stormwind.

95111.text:
In Tarren Mill there is a weaponsmith known as Ott. By all accounts he is an unremarkable smith, selling simple blades to travelers. I purchased a sword from him myself, and when I took it to the undercity for maintenance some time later, the smiths there were surprised at its quality. They assumed it came from a well-known master smith, but no, it was just Ott.

I'd like to give this orc a chance to do something truly special. Take the materials to Ott in Tarren Mill and offer him the commission.
95111.todo: Speak with Ott and ask him to forge your blade.

95125.text:
These are some truly fine materials, <class>. You honor me by allowing me to forge this blade for you and I only hope that I can live up to your expectations.

Please, stand back so that I may begin the forging process.
95125.todo: Watch as Ott forges your blade.

95126.text: Here's the blade. You said that a paladin named Trevan sent you? Please extend my thanks to him for this opportunity when you next see him. Go with honor, friend.
95126.todo: Bring Ott's Masterwork to Trevan Rol in Silverpine Forest.

95140.text:
I see that you have your weapon now, <class>. I pray that it will not fail you.

The locals tell me that Old Fire-Eye hunts in a large area south of here and you can generally find him near the gates to Gilneas. Find him, and use your new blade to end him. When it is done, return and you will have the gratitude of the Windshapers.
95140.todo: Use the Moonsilver Blade to destroy Old Fire-Eye in Silverpine Forest.

95161.text:
If you're looking for Jeremy Heartweaver, your best bet is to talk to his newly adopted mother, Avette Fellwood out in Duskwood. Sweet woman. Likely needs another pair of hands for her work, but it beats staying in the orphanage.

If you see little Jeremy, do be sure to tell him we're all thinking of him, won't you?
95161.todo: Deliver the Blood-Stained Letter to Avette Fellwood in Duskwood.

95189.text: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in Stormwind would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95189.todo: Return the Crest of Lordaeron to Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind City.

95195.text: <The old Alliance insignia appears to have belonged to a soldier of Lordaeron. These ruins are likely filled with similar medals that living relatives would be grateful to have returned to them.>
95195.todo: Collect 10 Bloodied Insignias and take them to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind City.

95204.text: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in the Undercity would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95204.todo: Bring the Crest of Lordaeron to Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity.

95212.text:
We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles.

Collect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm!
95212.todo: Collect 6 Pristine Leopard Pelts and deliver them to Amberstill Ranch.

95213.text:
The keg is stamped:

BLASTING POWDER - DANGER - DO NOT HANDLE - DANGER - QUARRYMASTER AUTHORIZATION ONLY - DANGER

You get a sinking feeling that the troggs shouldn't have this. It would be best to report this to the quarry sooner rather than later.
95213.todo: Bring the Empty Powder Keg to Quarrymaster Thesten at Gol'Bolar Quarry.

95214.text: This keg held enough powder to turn King Magni's throne room into an open air courtyard. We've got to get it back from the troggs before they work out how to ignite it.
95214.todo: Recover 16 Stolen Blasting Powder from the troggs east of Gol'Bolar Quarry, then return to Quarrymaster Thesten.

95216.text:
Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!

I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.
95216.todo: Collect the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang in Ruins of Lordaeron for Theodore Griffs in Undercity.

95217.text:
So you're looking to learn the blacksmith's trade? Maybe we can help each other.

The supply shipment's late, and I need materials for some repairs around the camp. If you get me what I need, I'll teach you some of my techniques. Sound fair?
95217.todo: Collect 12 Copper Bars and 4 Toughened Boar Hides and deliver them to Frast Dokner.

95250.text:
What do you want, <race>? Can't you see there is a war to be won?

My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I doubt you'll survive ten minutes in combat, but if it keeps your simple mind busy, why don't you seek out the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.
95250.todo: Collect the Head of the Baron in the Ruins of Lordaeron and bring it back to Captain Truman.

95314.text:
Before the Scourge invasion, the reclusive village of Shadowvale was known for its Whispering Elixir. Distilled from herbs found only in Tyr's Fall, the elixir was sought by apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners alike even after being banned in the city.

I've had requests from a number of buyers eager to get their hands on some elixir. Travel to the ruins of Shadowvale deep in the Whispering Forest to the west. I'm prepared to offer significant compensation if you can recover some bottles for me.
95314.todo: Collect 8 Bottles of Whispering Elixir from Shadowvale, then return to Carolai Anise in Brill.

95328.text: Against your better judgement you scrape up and collect the squirming remains of the beast. Someone in Undercity might have a use for them.
95328.todo: Deliver Whispering Horror Residue to Father Lankester in the War Quarter of Undercity.

95349.text:
The recent events with the cult have delayed my plans to travel to Azeroth and I must remain here in Valanaar for a time. You and a handful of other Windshapers will be our vanguard instead. Alaana Stormwalker will be waiting to receive our Windshapers upon arrival in Mulgore, and I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we finish our business here. We will join you soon.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.

Banu-Alah, <name>.
95349.todo: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alaana Stormwalker when you arrive.

95350.text:
It's a big world down here, and our new allies are the key to our survival.

The Earthen Ring is a member of the "Horde", a proud collection of like-minded peoples. The nearby city of Thunder Bluff is a part of the Horde, and further to the east lies the capital of Orgrimmar.

Seek out the flight master in the center of Thunder Bluff. They will fly you to Orgrimmar where you will make contact with the Horde warchief--Thrall, on behalf of the Windshapers. Winds guide you, <name>.
95350.todo: Travel to Orgrimmar and speak with Thrall in the Valley of Wisdom.

95384.text: <The strange symbols on the magical scroll confound you. Though you do not speak the language recorded, you don't sense any particularly volatile forces within. Perhaps a collector of odd magics would find some use for the scroll.>
95384.todo: Bring the partial scroll to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay.

95494.text:
I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.

The big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.
95494.todo: Collect 6 Savannah Lion Hides from the Savannah Matriarchs and Savannah Patriarchs in the Barrens.

95495.text:
These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.

Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.
95495.todo: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the hermit on the ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the Barrens.

95507.text:
While you are out there, it would be of great help to me if you could check on my traps for me. I've got them strewn all over the valley.

Bring back any small game that I've caught. Keep your eye out for the other wildlife, though. This area can be dangerous if you aren't paying attention.
95507.todo: Collect 8 Trapped Game from traps found in Sprung Traps in the Barrens.

95508.text:
Yes, I used to be a member of the Kul Tiras navy. After Lord Admiral took Theramore and started his campaign in Durotar, I had... "objections" to his methods. Particularly the methods involving executing civilians.

There's more to the story but... wait... what's that?

There's a group of men coming up the ridge!
95508.todo: Help Walton survive the encounter with Terry Longdrink and the Kul Tiras marines.

95534.text:
<The note is singed in places, but is still readable.>

Rumor has it those old bellows have a mind of their own, springing to life when no one is watching. I don't care if it's a ghost story, you'd better get to the bottom of it before I return.

There's great power in Strahnbrad, I know it.

< The rest of the note is singed and torn, as if burnt by fire magic. >
95534.todo: Solve the mystery of Strahnbrad and report your findings in town in Hillsbrad.

95621.text:
This morning I spotted a group of humans searching for something in the valley below. I managed to use my rifle's scope for a better look, and it was clear that they were soldiers sporting the livery of Kul Tiras.

If you'd be willing to take work from me, travel to where these soldiers made camp near the wrecked caravan to the south. Kill any you find and try to learn why they are here.
95621.todo: Travel to the wrecked caravan and learn more about why the Kul Tirans are here.

95646.text:
These brackish wetlands hold a greater well of unsalted southern waters. It pains me, yet within my roots I sense a corruption seeping through that mountain gully.

The creatures, like those in our lowlands, react more bitterly to the taint. Lacking the sea's hardening salt since life's dawn, they have little strength against such evil.

Go to those highlands, and bring me the Highland Horror's root core.
95646.todo: Kill a Highland Horror within Excavation Sites and bring its root core to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.

95647.text:
My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!

If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.
95647.todo: Find Ardin Grassman in the Excavation Sites.

95663.text:
The Dragonmaw are a formidable clan.

They're known for binding magic strong enough to make dragons serve, and rumor claims they're preparing some display of it in the Wetlands. Whether truth or bluster, the Deathstalkers can't act on half-formed whispers. Broken symbols carried only that much to me.

A deathstalker agent needs a hand in the hills above the Dragonmaw encampment. Meet her there. She'll reveal the next steps.
95663.todo: Travel to the Wetlands and meet the Deathstalker Agent in the hills above the Dragonmaw camp.

95664.text: This unusual composite shard scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient. The most knowledgeable minds for artifacts of this bygone age must reside on the Elder rise in Thunder Bluff.
95664.todo: Take the Titan Relic to the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff and look for someone who can tell you more about it.

95682.text:
Dragonmaw. <She lets out a dry, amused scoff.>

The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief?

Clear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected.

If the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.
95682.todo: Slay the Dragonmaw forces within the Excavation Site and return to the Deathstalker Agent outside with anything you recover.

95697.text:
Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.

Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.

A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.

Up for a job?
95697.todo: Enter the Excavation Sites in the Wetlands and bring back Thicket Raptor Meat.

95737.text:
From time to time, I correspond with others in my craft--herbalists or eccentrics who study rare plants and local oddities. We trade discoveries, and sometimes warnings of what lies ahead.

One alchemist in the Wetlands wrote of an excavation team her husband was part of, uncovering signs of a long-lost primordial grass... but she never sent word of its abundance or accessibility.

If you can, check on Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95737.todo: Speak with Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.

95748.text:
This is odd. This piece of the tablet you have brought me refers to the lost city of I'lalai as if it is a massive sprawling civilization. But the ruins off of the reef are not large enough to be something of that size.

<name>, to the north of the Vile Reef there is an ancient troll ruin on the hills along the coast. A tablet that contains legends of the lost troll city is within. I wish to study this legend further.

Take this hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of this tablet, then return to me.
95748.todo: Use the hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of the Third Troll Legend tablet.

95770.text:
After rereading the legend, it doesn't seem like we are in the wrong place for the lost city, but perhaps there is yet some detail that has been overlooked.

In my younger years I used to dive in the Vile Reef ruins, but that was before the murlocs settled there. If memory serves there was a cavern there.

I have heard that there are now naga gathering in that region, which is unusual. I want to know what has lured them there.

Go and explore just west of the Vile Reef and return to me with any news.
95770.todo: Explore the Vile Reef and find the cavern entrance.

95772.text:
Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the Wetlands with some diggin' crew out o' Loch Modan. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation.

Aye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit.

Daewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time.

If yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?
95772.todo: Look for Dorin Songblade's brother, Daewyn, in Whelgar's Excavation Site.

95773.text:
<class>, your arrival is timely. I have just received new reports of naga activity just off of our coast. They seem to be swarming around some old troll ruins near the ocean floor.

We are already stretched thin defending from the local Bloodscalp and ogres ransacking our caravans. We cannot afford a surprise attack from the sea.

Go and slay as many as you are able, and bring me their tridents as proof of your success.
95773.todo: Gather 10 Brinescale Tridents from Brinescale Skirmishers.

95774.text:
The healer who saved me could not save her, and she has died in battle. Her name is Olgra, and I will never forget her.

You did not find her adornments on her body? She wore many jewels of polished bone.

Slay the Razormane Raiders near where she fell, and find her precious works of art!

I will place them with the memorial that I build in her memory.
95774.todo: Slay quilboars and collect 4 of Olgra's Adornments for Mankrik's memorial.

95775.text:
What I am about to ask you is no small feat, <class>, and will likely require strong allies to accomplish.

I want to know more about the ruins on the other side of the cavern the naga are guarding. If my suspicions prove correct, it could indeed be the lost city of I'lalai. The amount of lost historical knowledge at our fingertips could be unrivaled, but I am too old to venture myself.

Enter the ruins and gather etchings of any tablets you find there, then return to me.
95775.todo: Use the hide and charcoal to create rubbings of the tablets found in the Drowned City.

95776.text:
You have done well to slay the naga just off of our coast, but the fact that they are in our waters in such numbers means there is yet a larger threat.

I have spoken to Kin'weelay, and he thinks these Brinescale naga are infiltrating the ruins of the Drowned City. If the naga are there, then they are up to no good and are likely searching for something.

We can't let them get their hands on anything that could compromise us here and it is time to put an end to this. Slay their leader and return to me.
95776.todo: Slay Var'Taka in the Drowned City.

95795.text:
<You cover the dwarf's body with his cloak.>

Travel to Lakeshire and personally inform Dorin Songblade what became of his brother within the Excavation Sites.

95803.text:
Now that we've claimed the head of the tarnished commander, I need you to deliver it to the Undercity. Sylvanas Windrunner mistrusts us greatly, and all but openly disparages us.

Deliver Rudolph Gelhardt's head to the Dark Lady. Show her that we tend to our own house and are devoted to the prosperity of the forsaken.
95803.todo: Bring the head of Rudolph Gelhardt to Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.

95805.text:
The sun and the moon, An'she and Mu'sha, are not part of our world like the elements, yet their light gives us life, guidance, and hope.

We pay respect to the spirits of the world, and so we pay respect to the twins as well.

If you would show your respect, take this smoldering incense and bring it to a shrine in the hills to the southeast, overlooking the mesa, south of the quilboar. Be quick, so that you can reach the shrine before the incense burns away.

Don't get it wet!
95805.todo: Carry the Smoldering Incense to the shrine of An'she and Mu'sha in the southeastern hills before the incense burns to ash in ten minutes!

95809.text:
I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.

<He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.>

Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.

Thank you.
95809.todo: Return to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.

95810.text:
You pick up a fractured piece of the rock-mech automaton. It has a texture unlike anything you've touched before, a composite material of unknown makeup. This is certainly bound to be more 'device' than 'debris.'

Prospector Whelgar himself at his excavation site might have something useful to share about the relic.
95810.todo: Bring the Titan Relic to Prospector Whelgar in the Wetlands excavation site.

95816.text:
Greetings, accomplished craftsperson!

Completion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth!

Once completed, please bring this to your local Azeroth Commerce Authority branch's Contract Coordinator to begin processing.

Happy crafting!
95816.todo: Bring the completed form to Elaine Compton in Redridge Mountains.

95817.text:
Have you ever met Rotgath Stonebeard? He is a dwarven blacksmith in Ironforge. Not the most chatty fellow around, but always reliable. We often come to him when we need bulk crafts of simpler designs--the kind that Stondry is too proud to take on himself.

His turnaround times are excellent, particularly when it comes to helping new craftspeople get their shops established. I would trust no other to get your sign made fast. Let him know I sent you if he gives you any trouble!
95817.todo: Meet Rotgath Stonebeard near the Great Forge in Ironforge.

95818.text:
We can get ye sorted out and out of here in no time, provided you have the materials on hand! We are going to need 25 Mithril Bars and 15 Heavy Leather. Normally we need some other metals and the like too, but I've got some scrap that's been taking up space we can use for those extra bits.

Oh, as a personal favor, I am gonnae ask for 5 Goldthorn as well. My wife knows a great recipe for tea and I'd like to surprise her. Consider this your payment!
95818.todo: Bring the requested materials to Rotgath Stonebeard near the Great Forge in Ironforge.

95819.text:
Greetings, accomplished craftsperson!

Completion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth!

Once completed, please bring this to your local Durotar Supply & Logistics Contract Coordinator to begin processing.

Happy crafting!
95819.todo: Bring the completed form to Jornah in The Barrens.

95883.text:
<The preparations for a hastily-assembled ritual are gathered unceremoniously on the altar. According to the scrap of note, everything has been gathered. All that's missing are the offering of blood and the Tortured Soul.

The undead around you look tortured enough. They may have what you seek.>
95883.todo: Collect a Tortured Soul from the nearby undead in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.

95884.text:
<The scrap of note is mostly illegible. What is still readable, however, are notes about preparations for an offering.

An offering stone is mentioned, as well as a ritual.

Perhaps you can find this offering stone nearby.>
95884.todo: Find the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.

95885.text:
<All that's left now is the offering of blood.

The note scrap mentioned a 'willing sacrifice.'

An intense sense of dread washes over you.>
95885.todo: Use the Tortured Soul to give an offering of blood at the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril.

95981.text:
Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin Tor really are shipping a steady supply of relics from Dalaran, we must stop them at the source.

Search the roads around Ambermill for Dalaran's wizards and watchers. Their presence has allowed free access across our borders for too long. If we can cull their numbers, that should put a stop to these pendants making it into Silverpine Forest in the first place.
95981.todo: Slay 8 Dalaran Wizards and 8 Dalaran Watchers for Shadow Priest Allister in the Sepulcher.

95998.text:
Well howdy there, <class>. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.
95998.todo: Sit near Sam's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

95999.text:
Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.

Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.
95999.todo: Deliver the Broken Staff of Incinerator Gar'im to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.

96016.text:
Ye did good, and I can see yer itchin' fer yer reward. Sorry tae say, I'm not exactly a dwarf of many possessions.

<Veyric gestures broadly at his remote location.>

Tell ye what, though. I hear a troll named the Windwatcher lives out in the Alterac Mountains. He's a powerful shaman himself, and an expert in storm elementals. If ye bring that there elemental core to him, I bet he can make ye a weapon worthy of yer victory.
96016.todo: Deliver the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac Mountains.

96031.text:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, <class>. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
96031.todo: Speak with Gretta Finespindle in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

96044.text:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
96044.todo: Speak with Tognus Flintfire in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

96045.text: Now that you've taken up Alchemy, I can also teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp once you've learned a bit. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
96045.todo: Speak with Vosur Brakthel in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

96046.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
96046.todo: Speak with Yarr Hammerstone in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

96047.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a <class>.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
96047.todo: Speak with Thamner Pol in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

96050.text:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
96050.todo: Speak with Paxton Ganter near Iceflow Lake in Dun Morogh to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

96055.text:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
96055.todo: Speak with Reyna Stonebranch in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

96056.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
96056.todo: Speak with Balthus Stoneflayer in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

96057.text:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
96057.todo: Speak with Uthrar Threx in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

96058.text:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
96058.todo: Speak with Bronk Guzzlegear in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

96059.text:
Now that you've begun your journey into being an enchanter, I reckon I can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp once you've learned the ropes.

It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
96059.todo: Speak with Thonys Pillarstone in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

96101.text:
Greetings, <class>. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96101.todo: Sit near Raan's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

96102.text:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
96102.todo: Speak with Snang in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

96130.text:
Among the prairie wolves that hunt the hills nearby is one that is especially aggressive. We have taken to calling her Chakuyak. She has become a threat to travelers coming from abroad.

She stalks the trees west of Stonebull Lake, moving from tree stand to tree stand.

End this threat and bring me her pelt, and I will speak your praises to the chief. Beware, for she is dangerous! You might see other hunters seeking her out there, and perhaps you could work as a team.
96130.todo: Defeat Chakuyak and bring back her pelt.

96135.text:
Euck, just bein' around these blasted totems is givin' me the willies--but that's good. This much twisted corruption will be exactly what we need tae summon the quilboar's elementals.

Go to the Thousand Needles and find a suitable spot for your defenses. The steam pools should work. They're rich with fire, earth, water, and air alike. Place these totems and be ready for a fight. The Razormane won't take too kindly to yer interference.
96135.todo: Use the Twisted Totems to put an end to the quilboar ritual.

96136.text:
As you have no doubt experienced yourself, the elements of Azeroth are unique to those in Zephras. It is one thing to channel the forces of nature within the elemental plains, and another thing entirely to do it down here in the muck.

I could grant you your totem of air, but I think it would do you more good to meet with the one who trains the other earth-bound initiates. What say you, <name>?
96136.todo: Find Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.

96137.text:
A small dagger belonging to the self-appointed ranger, Ira, who kept the forests safe by preventing the beasts within from attacking travelers.

With Ira's spirit still wandering the woods, perhaps her unfinished business was to clear out the worg that continue to claim victims throughout the forest.
96137.todo: Defeat 10 Young Black Ravagers and 7 Black Ravagers then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.

96138.text:
A bow left by the spirit of Merrick Valor, famed Watcher who prided himself on keeping the roads safe from encroaching enemies.

With Merrick's spirit still wandering the roads, perhaps his unfinished business was to clear out invaders near his home in Raven Hill. The ogres south of town may be what's troubling his spirit.
96138.todo: Defeat 8 Splint Fist Warriors and 4 Splint Fist Taskmasters then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.

96139.text:
In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.

Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.

If you happen to find anything, I'd appreciate it if you brought it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.
96139.todo: Search Raven Hill for anything of interest and return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.

96204.text:
Now that I'm free I'm going to make these vile creatures regret ever laying eyes on a Windshaper.

Let's get out of here, <class>.
96204.todo: Accompany Lumina Windsinger and help her escape Fenris Keep.

96222.text:
While war rages throughout the region, the Maraudine centaur stand unchallenged in the Valley of Spears. I worry that they will grow callous in time and stir further unrest if the other clans continue to turn a blind eye to their presence.

Khan Hratha possesses a Maraudine Key Fragment, and I wish to have it as a negotiation tactic. Find a war horn mouthpiece from the centaur there and use it to challenge him atop the highest peak.

Bring the key to me, and I will have a proposition for you.
96222.todo: Bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Umarak in the Desolace.

96241.text:
Something funny be happenin' over there at Gloomrise. Ol' Mazu'kon be hearin all about these nasty new beasties skitterin' all around there.

Some say those creepy crawlies got a venom that have some unique properties and this be gettin' me curious. Take my extractor. Use it on the dead bodies layin' around that place to harvest the venom. Do this and I be in ya debt, mon.
96241.todo: Use the Toxin Extractor to gather 5 Gloomrise Toxin Samples from the Gnawed Corpses at Gloomrise.

96243.text:
It's past time ye heeded the earth, brave Shaman. The elements already prickle in yer skin, but once ye speak with the stone, the ground itself'll set firm 'neath yer soles--and in yer soul.

Seek out Teo Hammerstorm, in Coldridge Valley. Ye'll find him within Anvilmar, a holdfast forged by hammer, fire, and will.
96243.todo: Find Teo Hammerstorm in Dun Morogh.

96259.text:
There is an ancient tauren burial ground at the place called Gloomrise, just northwest of this camp. Of late it has been infested with a particularly vicious brood of spiders. These spiders not only pose a threat to the people of Mulgore, they are also damaging a site that most tauren consider to be sacred.

It would be of great service if you could travel to Gloomrise and put an end to this infestation. The ancestors will surely smile upon you if you see this done.
96259.todo: Kill 10 Gloomrise Hatchlings and 5 Gloomrise Soldiers.

96260.text:
Have you heard what befell the burial ground at Gloomrise? Giant spiders--rumored to have a venom so strong that it can wake the dead--have spread like wildfire. Nasty business, if you ask me.

One of the scouts dispatched to investigate returned half dead and covered in an incredibly resilient, crystalline spider silk. I harvested what I could, but I would highly value more samples of this silk for additional study.

Bring me more of this crystalline silk and I will reward you.
96260.todo: Gather 3 strands of Crystalline Silk from Gloomrise Spinners.

96261.text:
As is often the case with infestations such as the one we are facing at Gloomrise, a single powerful matriarch often leads to the rapid spread of a hostile spider population.

If we wish to drive these beasts off for good, we'll need to seek out the progenitor and end her. When you go to Gloomrise, seek out the broodmother there and destroy her. I'd advise you to bring allies, and be ready for anything. These seem to be no ordinary spiders.

96264.text:
So yer a big shot shaman now, eh? Ye've mastered the elements and want tae put 'em to good use? I think I got just the thing.

If ye want the elements' respect, ye gotta repay yer debts to 'em. They help you, you help them. And right now they need all the help they can get from those who would abuse their power.
