97977.text:
The Gnarlpine furbolg would not turn on their ancient allies so readily. We must learn more of their plight.

Search their abandoned homes for totems. If any survived the chaos of their departure, their engravings may tell us more of what happened here.

You'll find their camps along the western edge of the glen, though the grell and grellkin may have scattered them beyond.
97977.todo: Collect 4 Gnarlpine Totems and bring them to Tarindrella.

97979.text:
You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and have inherited a birthright unlike any other in this world. Elune's grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.

Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.

Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.

97985.text:
Fascinating, aren't they? This is the first time I have ever been privy to the secrets of abomination creation.

I have been studying these notes, and it appears we need a heart. A massive one!

I hear there is a thunder lizard there of impressive size called Stormheart, that patrols along the canyon edge in Thousand Needles. With a name like that it must have the perfect heart. I must have that heart!

Oh, also I suggest you bring friends. Stormheart isn't known for being docile.
97985.todo: Slay Stormheart in Thousand Needles and acquire its heart.

98013.text:
Steel yourself for your time in the ruins, young one... you will not be granted free passage there.

Scores of cursed Highborne, now known as naga, roam the once great city. Travel northeast and dispatch them from this land.

What they once were... is no more. If they aid the Twilight's Hammer, they can bring only further pain to the forests that once gave them shelter.

War is what they seek, <class>. War... is what we will bring.
98013.todo: Eliminate 12 Stormscale Myrmidons, 8 Stormscale Sorceresses, and 6 Stormscale Warriors for Arbal at the Grove of the Ancients.

98021.text:
If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, I'd recommend reporting to a man named Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall to the south, at the settlement known as Sentinel Hill. His people are in need of aid.

After journeying here from another plane of existence, the problems our lands face may seem small. I assure you, the aid you provide to those impacted by such problems means everything to them, and you will grow stronger for your labors.

Good luck out there, adventurer!
98021.todo: Report To Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

98024.text:
After journeying here from the elemental plane, the problems our lands face may seem small. Rest assured, the dangers the horde faces are very real, and you will grow formidable should you survive your service.

If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, travel southwest to the vast lands known as the Barrens. There is a settlement there known as the Crossroads. The proud citizens there are ever in need of aid.

Go with honor, adventurer!
98024.todo: Report To Thork at The Crossroads in The Barrens.

98025.text:
Attention!

A reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also known as "Swordfeather".

Unfortunately this owl has gone mad and has begun to attack travelers as they journey along the road near Auberdine.

Jai'vhanel was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Bring back one of her jet black feathers as proof of her death.

Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

The Auberdine Village Council
98025.todo: Find and slay the owl known as Jai'vhanel and take one of her feathers. The black owl was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Report the death of Jai'vhanel to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

98027.text:
<The silver necklace in your hands gleams gently as you examine it. The small crescent moon shape seems similar to other night elf symbols you've seen before.

Upon flipping the necklace over there is a small inscription: "Alor'lormah, Maliynn". Perhaps it belongs to Maliynn in Astranaar?>
98027.todo: Deliver the Crescent Necklace to Maliynn in Astranaar.

98028.text:
All that remains of the powerful elemental is a globe of what seems to be pure water, clouded by some unknown substance. The edges of the sphere seem to be clear until you turn it--as if the cloud actively prevents you from peering within.

Whatever happened to it--and to the ruins it was guarding--is still active in some way.

Only Onu, the Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients to the far south, would have a chance at knowing more.
98028.todo: Bring the Clouded Water Globe to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.

98042.text:
<As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>

They have failed.

You will be forgotten.

They will lose the eye they gained.
98042.todo: Obtain a Peerless Eye from a Twilight Disciple or Thug at the Master's Glaive in Darkshore and find someone in Auberdine who is willing to take it.

98046.text:
<Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm's gaze narrows.>

You're still here?

Take the phial and get out of my sight, <class>. It is clear my answers do not lie in the waters, just as they did not before.

Perhaps one of the priestesses in the Temple of the Moon to the south will dispose of it.

<Fandral looks away, no longer speaking to you.>

I must look elsewhere if this is to work...
98046.todo: Bring the Drained Vessel to Lariia in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

98059.text:
Hillsbrad's council hasn't answered our new magistrate's letters. The last word I pried out of a passing merchant from the town did little to justify their silence.

We're only asking for a small platoon--yet I'm told multiple siege ballista rest in pristine condition within a walled-off compound.

Walk into their town hall like a citizen returning a census request, and place this neatly upon the bookkeeping table.

Return to me when the deed is done.
98059.todo: Place the Sealed Company Request you were given on the bookkeeping table within Hillsbrad's town hall.

98065.text:
You must bring this to Tyrande at once! I will transfer it to a more ceremonial container for you.

Do not be afraid. The High Priestess of Elune is firm, but kind. She protects all who enter Darnassus, and carries our goddess' light to all.

She will be glad to receive this sacred water. You will find her directly above us.
98065.todo: Bring the Moonwell Remnants to Tyrande Whisperwind in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

98067.text:
General Feathermoon ensures all sentinels have time to pray to Elune. A proper huntress wields not blade alone, but gifts of the goddess to overcome our enemies.

You may help with my daily duties. Place sentinels around the city--start with the tunnels leading beneath Cenarion Hold to the north, the bank at the center of town, the inn in the Craftsman's Terrace to the northeast, and the city gates. The guards can assist you.

Something is amiss in Teldrassil--we must remain vigilant.
98067.todo: Place Sentinel Owls at the entrance to the Cenarion Hold depths, the Darnassus Bank, the Craftsman's Terrace Inn, and the City Gate for Sentinel Dalia Sunblade in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

98069.text:
Those wretched harpies! They attacked the last caravan I had scheduled to deliver supplies to Freewind Post. We have enough supplies for the moment, but without more supplies, we'll run short soon.

I'm not sure what the harpies plan to do with the extra supplies, but I would be grateful if you would recover them for me. They make their lair west of here. They can be found both at the base of the cliffside and inside a cave at the top.
98069.todo: Bring 8 Stolen Freewind Supplies to Jandia in Freewind Post.

98070.text:
The Screeching Canyon is home to a local band of harpies known for their ferocious nature and raiding tactics. They have ambushed the last few supply caravans that have been brave enough to traverse this place.

I fear if something isn't done soon, there will be no caravans that will dare make the trek to Freewind Post.

Go, slay as many of these harpies as you are able. Return to me once the deed has been done, and I will reward you well for your efforts.
98070.todo: Slay 5 Screeching Harpies, 5 Screeching Roguefeather Harpies and 5 Screeching Windcaller Harpies.

98071.text:
Worked a bit o' a trade with the Dun Garok brew-kin. We're not the only ones missin' the vineyards of the Fallrook family, it seems! Most o' the best bottled years are long since drank, but we do have cases of the wine still in the cellars.

Bring this case of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in the southeast and leave it with 'em by their gatherin' fireplace at the bottom of their fort.

In return, carry a sack o' the Homebrew Hops back with ye.

That keep is the closest thing to home around here!
98071.todo: Deliver the bottles of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in southeast Hillsbrad Foothills, and bring back a sack of their Homebrew Hops.

98072.text:
You're quite the go-getter! I have just one more favor to ask, if you're up for something a bit more dangerous.

The crocolisk trade is steady money, but they're small fish compared to what whelp scales will bring. Folks will pay top dollar for a sack of those.

Crocs of the sky, I call 'em! There's no way my apprentice could get them--but it seems right up your alley!

You'll find whelps far to the east, along the Green Belt. But be careful, there's nasty orcs in those hills!
98072.todo: Collect 8 Pristine Crimson Scales and bring them to James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.

98093.text:
I'm so glad you saw me!

The weather was lovely this morning, so I walked from Camp Taurajo down the golden road. When it came time to head back, I couldn't--a pack of hyenas started circling, and Stormhide lizards blocked my only escape.

Scrambling up this tree I went, and now there are too many foes about at this hour for me to make the run home through the fields.

Would you mind clearing out these Stormhide and Hecklefang Stalkers for me?
98093.todo: Sulhasa in southern Barrens wants you to clear out 7 Stormhide lizards and 7 Hecklefang Stalkers in the area so she can leave the tree safely.

98094.text:
Now that we can trust you to deliver critical information to our forward spies, there's an extra task for you.

Bring this to Deathstalker Masoj almost directly south of us. He'll have more for you to do once you get there and hand this to him. He is posted on elevated terrain north of the rotten vineyard they call Nethander Stead.

Our plan to take control of these lands continues steadily.
98094.todo: High Executor Darthalia wants you to deliver updated orders to Deathstalker Masoj, south of Tarren Mill, outside of Dun Garok.

98095.text:
Our high command inserts strategic troops using bat riders. Key points around the foothills have lost their signaling beacons.

Take these vials. Uncork them in three locations: the hills bordering Dun Garok, the plateau overlooking Dunholde Keep, and the last on the ridge of the Headland above the town of Hillsbrad. The vapors that emanate will be like a potent tuning rod to the senses of the bat, drawing them to the desired drop-off points once more.

Look for crushed empty vials and renew our marks.
98095.todo: Deathstalker Masoj needs you to place the three Apothecary Vials on peaks around Hillsbrad Foothills and return to him.

98155.text:
The Pesterhide hyenas of Thousand Needles have the most gorgeous coats. I haven't seen such a brilliant hue of fur like that in all of my travels!

I would like to send back some pelts to my sisters back in Stormwind, as I know they could make something incredible out of them.

I don't have any fighting experience, so I would be very grateful if you could gather some of the Pesterhide pelts in my stead.
98155.todo: Bring 5 Pristine Pesterhide Pelts to Kristy Grant.

98156.text:
<name>, you have been so helpful to me I hate to ask for yet another favor. It will be some time until I am able to return home to Stormwind. I was wondering if you would mind delivering these pelts to my sisters in my stead?

I am sure you are more likely to return there before I am able to. Please deliver these pelts to my sisters Kelly and Kimberly in Stormwind. They can usually be found in the Park.
98156.todo: Bring the Package of Pristine Pelts to Kimberly Grant.

98189.text:
My goodness, it's--it's beautiful!

The Blind Princess was to deliver this to Menethil Harbor before tragedy struck. We were so close!

I believe it was to be signed for by Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep just behind us. Why don't you do the honors of finishing the job?
98189.todo: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.

98190.text:
You'll want to take this to Stormwind right away. Proud as I am that this keep and harbor bears King Terenas Menethil II's name, we are a calm harbor in a very nasty storm of enemies. It's just not safe here.

The Dragonmaw in particular would sacrifice much to loot something like this... and I shudder to think of what they'd do with it.

Don't bother going up the chain of command on this one, <lad/lass>. Go straight to Highlord Fordragon with this. He'll know where it will be best kept.
98190.todo: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.

98191.text:
King Terenas was a good man. A devout man. Beloved by his people, and truly the reason we have this Alliance at all.

The irony is he was humble--he hated these sorts of memorials, and so precious few exist. And of those, few survived Lordaeron's fall.

It seems the Light has coalesced in this statuette. It would be best kept in the Cathedral of the Light in Cathedral Square, in the center of the city. Bring it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for safekeeping.
98191.todo: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral of Light.

98197.text:
This harbor was first built by the Old Horde as a staging ground for their naval invasion of Hillsbrad. Completely circumvented Lordaeron's defenses!

So many lives lost...

What's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!

Plenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.
98197.todo: Recover 6 Khaz Modan Timber and 30 Khaz Modan Iron from Menethil Harbor for Valstag Ironjaw.

98208.text:
I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people.

My people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el--Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home.

Please help me retrieve it! The wreckage is just south of the city, but it is inhabited by fierce murloc raiders!
98208.todo: Recover Nord'el for Sylessa Duskwhisper in Menethil Harbor.

98209.text:
Would you please deliver Nord'el to elder Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine?

The boat from here should be able to get you there swiftly.

I apologize for the request, I truly do. I remain fatigued from my journey here--and from fleeing those murloc devils when I first attempted to retrieve the sacred bloom!
98209.todo: Bring Nord'el to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore.

98216.text:
Old Gods?! This cannot be good news at all!

I've made out a new bit on the stone that speaks of a guardian of some kind. Whatever it is, it must be linked to the stone!

Take it with you and see if you can find a big Titan construct of some sort in the excavation. Read this here final passage on the stone and see what happens!

If I'm right, you'll activate the thing. Take it out if so, but try to preserve anything interesting! We simply must know more!
98216.todo: Use the Goaz Stone near the Goaz Warder and bring its Titanic Keystone back to Prospector Whelgar.

98219.text:
Thank you again for delivering the statuette safely, <name>.

I could use your help with something else. There's a member of the city guard who was reassigned to duty in Southshore out in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

His father was a friend of mine, and while I don't disagree that he could use the lesson... I'd still like to see him succeed. He would really benefit from someone like you helping him out.

There is a boat that can take you that way from Menethil Harbor, if you are passing back through.
98219.todo: Speak to Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

98221.text:
In the Second War the Dragonmaw built a fleet where we now stand, intending to take Hillsbrad. They nearly succeeded!

They were routed by the red dragons, left to mere stragglers deep in the mountains. However, there has been a surge in activity in their encampment northeast of Menethil.

Dun Algaz is proof that they intend to march to war once again and retake this land. Find their attack plans, take note of any critical information, and destroy them. We need to know where they will strike next!
98221.todo: Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep wants you to destroy the 4 sets of Attack Plans in the Angerfang Encampment.

98223.text:
This book has been badly burned--perhaps by the dragonfire that destroyed much of the Dragonmaw clan.

Of what little is legible, it seems to describe rituals relating to the use of the Demon Soul that the clan had used to control the dragons.

It is far too incomplete to be of real use, but based on roughly inserted pages on animal hide it seems Nek'rosh had attempted to salvage it. Freshly dried ink mentions a "Shadow Council."

Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor would want to know about this.
98223.todo: Bring the Tattered Spellbook to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor.

98230.text:
After the War of the Three Hammers that tore dwarven life as we knew it apart, the Wildhammers settled here, founding the mountain fortress of Grim Batol.

It was a wondrous place. Gryphons soared everywhere you looked, diving down through the wetlands to grab a fish.

It didn't last long, sadly.

Howin Kindfeather is one of the first Wildhammers to return in ages. Keeps to himself, far outside of town. Follow the road east--you'll find him eventually. He could surely use a hand.
98230.todo: Find Howin Kindfeather east of Menethil Harbor, along the road.

98240.text:
Word is officially out on those whelps, <name>. We already have an order in!

I'll package 'em up all nice for you, then you take it out to the customer. I know, I know; it's just one last favor, I promise!

These will be for one "Howin Kindfeather". Sent his gryphon into town of all things with a letter for the order! Says he's just off the road to the east, a bit past Whelgar's Excavation Site, if you're familiar.
98240.todo: Bring the Crimson Crate to Howin Kindfeather off the road to the east of Menethil Harbor.

98245.text:
I don't know who I hate more: the bloody Dark Irons, the Dragonmaw, or the drakes they rode.

<Howin spits.>

I aim tae make things right. But we're gonna need some supplies.

These whelp scales will protect against dragonfire a good bit, but they're a pain in the arse tae weave together.

The Razormaw raptors up in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest are so named for their pointy chompers--they oughta break through the scales.

Bring me a handful of the incisors.
98245.todo: Collect 10 Razormaw Incisors for Howin Kindfeather.

98246.text:
I'll need some eggs if my plan is going tae work. Bassbeak needs a nice an' full belly--I ain't in the business of hoppin' on the back of a surly gryphon.

They need to be perfect--no cracks or anything.

Take some from the Razormaw raptors--they're known for having yolks the size of a gnome's noggin. You can find 'em in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest.

Let's make it a nice even dozen, just to be safe.
98246.todo: Gather 12 Perfect Razormaw Eggs for Howin Kindfeather.

98247.text:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Property of the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Please return empty crates or unfulfilled shipments to our local trade hub at the Three Corners crossroads in Redridge Mountains. Couriers will be compensated for their time and travel."

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
98247.todo: Deliver the Shipping Label to someone at the Azeroth Commerce Authority trade hub in Redridge Mountains.

98248.text:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Return damaged shipments or empty crates to the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade outpost, now conveniently located due west of the Crossroads in the Barrens. Your time is valuable and we will compensate you for your efforts!"

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
98248.todo: Deliver the Shipping Label to someone at the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade hub near the Crossroads in the Barrens.

98251.text:
Gaaah!

I'm so angry. They said Ashenvale was easy to follow. Easy for who? The beasts? The birds?

One moment I was gathering an herb, the next I'm trapped in this ravine. Do I truly have to circle half the forest to reach where I stood just moments ago?

When I'm like this, my spells grow volatile and behave... differently.

Could you thin the wildlife nearby? Even their stupid hooves grate on me. I despise this cursed forest.
98251.todo: Kill 6 Shadowhorn Stag and 6 Ashenvale Bear and return to Va'xug Firefure northwest of Fallen Sky Lake.

98252.text:
Show my Eye of Kilrogg the way out of this ravine and back to the Ashenvale road. Keep it moving and I'll follow once I see a clear path.

I'll stay here--one of us should keep our bearings. If you lose the way, I can guide you back through the eye. I will not have us both wandering blind in this malicious forest.

I can hold the channel for four minutes. No longer. Reach the road before the vision breaks, or return to me and we try again.
98252.todo: Show Va'xug's Eye of Kilrogg the way back to the main Ashenvale road.

98282.text:
Certain alchemical recipes require ingredients sourced from, well, very dangerous places. And those are often just the base herbs! The other ingredients are even worse!

I need to make more antivenom before I can leave again. I swear everything in this marsh is venomous. It's like it runs through the land itself!

Can you help me? I'll need a venom gland from the spiders in Thelgen Rock to the far southeast. But it has to be unruptured, or too much venom will spill out before you can get here. Sorry!
98282.todo: Collect an Unruptured Stalker Gland from Thelgen Rock for Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.

98283.text:
The natural order of this land is breaking. Once it was that the Razormaw raptors kept the land from overgrowth. They now live in fear of their alpha, named only for the carnage it leaves behind.

I fear the beast has been driven mad by the sickness that we have yet to fully excise.

It will respond to the malignant flesh of the diseased bears below Raptor Ridge, to the northeast. Leave their entrails in its cave lair.

Carnage will come. Bring me its head.
98283.todo: Bring Carnage's Head to Rethiel the Greenwarden in The Green Belt.

98284.text:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
98284.todo: Speak with Nasalanna Windsinger in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

98285.text:
An engineer is ever-resourceful, and if you are in the wilds alone, it's always good to be able to put your trade to use. No good camp is complete without a few helpful constructs!

Yes, come back and see me when you've gained a little bit of experience as an engineer and I can show you how to make something special!
98285.todo: Speak with the Strange Hermit in Shadowgale Forest to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

98286.text:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
98286.todo: Speak with Nasalanna Windsinger in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

98287.text:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
98287.todo: Speak with Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

98291.text:
I plan tae get back into Grim Batol and reclaim it for the Wildhammers, <name>. Or at least learn a thing or two.

Don't look at me like that, now. I know the risks. I don't intend tae go in hammer swingin', ye know.

Regardless, I'll need your help first. The Dragonmaw orcs march as we speak. They're all up an' down the Dragonmaw Retreat, where the red dragons routed them before.

I need you tae thin their numbers before I have any chance of gettin' close. Ye can't miss 'em if you follow the road east.
98291.todo: Kill 8 Dragonmaw Reclaimers, 5 Dragonmaw Soulbinders, and 3 Dragonmaw Infiltrators in Dragonmaw Retreat for Howin Kindfeather.

98293.text:
The Dragonmaw are stockpiling all manner of weaponry. It would be wise to relieve them of these before more soldiers can be armed.

Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep would surely be interested in these.
98293.todo: Collect 30 Dragonmaw Armaments in Dragonmaw Retreat, then bring them to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.

98297.text:
I did a quick test flight while ye were out. The good news is the armor ye helped me craft for Bassbeak works like a charm!

The very bad news is I saw a group o' them Dragonmaw in the process of enslavin' a red dragonspawn.

Absolutely not. Not again.

You have tae take it out. You'll certainly need friends tae do so. Kill the warlocks holding it down first--that ought tae free it. Then put it out of its misery.

None of them will stand in the way of the Wildhammer.
98297.todo: Kill the Subdued Dragonspawn at the Dragonmaw Gates for Howin Kindfeather.

98298.text:
Ah, it's all become so embarrassingly clear! Arugal hardly had any magic at all, let alone enough to create the worgen. 'Arugal's Curse.' Pah! Barely potent enough to last a few seconds.

These shackles prove he can bind the beasts, not create them. The worgen clearly spread their curse a different way. I would know how.

Go to the Greymane Wall to the south. The worgen seem to be spreading to the humans nearby. Tear the beasts apart and bring me whatever you find. This requires a more direct approach.
98298.todo: Bring 6 Worgen Bits to Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.

98299.text:
If there is one thing we do know, it is that Arugal is responsible for worgen within Silverpine--be it his own machinations or otherwise. What we don't know is how it spreads.

While I research a way to stop the curse, our first priority is to contain it. It appears this affliction cannot infect forsaken, but a large group of humans have gathered by the Greymane Wall.

Go to the wall and put down these refugees before they have a chance to become servants for Arugal. And try not to get bit, <race>.
98299.todo: Slay 5 Sickly Refugees and 5 Haggard Refugees for Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.

98300.text:
My work here is far from over, <name>. And I need tae send word to me wife Claira in Aerie Peak--and get Falstad an update as well.

But that's my business. Wildhammer business.

That said, you ought tae let King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge know about all this as well. Wetlands is but a stone's throw from his lands, and none of what's happenin' here is good news on one's doorstep. This letter oughta do the trick.

Ye can travel back through Dun Algaz or fly from Menethil Harbor to get to Ironforge.
98300.todo: Deliver Howin's Missive to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.

98310.text:
There are other, larger golems all around the Wetlands. They each bear inscriptions marking them as Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru--matching the missing pieces of the Goaz Stone you found!

I'd be willing to bet if we can bring pieces of them as well, we'll reveal more of the Goaz Stone!

You'll find Ados at the Dragonmaw Gates to the east, near Grim Batol. Modr is right outside Dun Modr to the north. Golm lies beneath Grim Batol, east of Dun Algaz. Neru's behind Direforge Hill, to the northeast.
98310.todo: Use the Goaz Stone near Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru and bring their hearts back to Prospector Whelgar.

98313.text:
Whatever this is all about, <name>, it's epic stuff alright.

I'll bundle everything up nice for you. Take it to Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. You'll usually find him in the back, nose-deep in some tome or another in the library.

It'll take a downright army to crack the case on this one, but if what we've seen so far is any indication it will well be worth it!
98313.todo: Bring the Whelgar Relic Package to Historian Karnik in Ironforge.

98319.text:
It's bad enough havin' a troll problem, but the mountains are filled tae the brim with wendigos! They normally keep to their own caves, but they seem tae be spreadin' like bunnies. Now they've filled the Grizzled Den north of here.

If we want Whitebeard's report, we're gonna need to find my partner Cornelius. The blockhead got a little too excited and charged in head first. Brave, but stupid.

Head into the cave and see where he is. And feel free to take out some of the beasts while yer at it.
98319.todo: Find Mountaineer Cornelius in the Grizzled Den for Mountaineer Gretchen.

98321.text:
Hoha! Good to see a <race> who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.

If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!

Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.
98321.todo: Collect 8 Flintfire Shipments from the Grizzled Den for Tongus Flintfire in Kharanos.

98322.text:
Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge.

Trouble is, one of my reports hasn't... well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them.

If you're already going to be out and about, what say you check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!
98322.todo: Check in on Mountaineer Gretchen west of Kharanos.

98323.text:
Hopefully ye put down a fair number of the mongrels while you were in there. Shame about Cornelius, though.

From what you described, there's not much to report other than the cave is a lost cause. Whitebeard's not gonna like that answer, but I'm not darin' sendin' anybody else into that death trap.

Feel free tae pass along the message, <name>. I'm not leavin' this spot till the mountain's secure.
98323.todo: Deliver Mountaineer Gretchen's Report back to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.

98326.text:
Do ye know how hard it is to fish on a frozen lake? My poor husband, Paxton, has been out in the middle of it for days and we barely have a single sack to show fer it.

Well, we DID have a sack to show fer it. Until the thrice-damned wendigo attacked me and made off with our haul. It'll take us weeks to fish all that back up! If that loudmouth Frosthowl didn't scare 'em all off, anyway.

Do us a favor and get it back, aye? Drooling brute is hiding somewhere deep in the Grizzled Den to the southeast.
98326.todo: Slay Frosthowl and collect the Sack of Fish for Gretta Ganter in Brewnall Village.

98340.text:
It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young druid. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
98340.todo: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

98341.text:
A spirit of your homeland has recently appeared here and has asked me to guide you to it. This windborne cat spirit has come to tutor and mentor you so that you may take the feline shape of the spirit on Zephras.

All druids eventually seek this wisdom, though it seems your homeland has a slightly different shape than our traditional one. If you desire to take this spirit's feline form, you will need to undergo our trial.

It can be found in the southern part of Moonglade, south of the twin bridges.
98341.todo: Seek out the Avatar of Saeyleenan in the southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the windborne cat.

98342.text:
To draw upon my spirit, you will need more than a few words. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics of my favor you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me. We will see if you are ready to take my shape.
98342.todo: Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Great Cat Spirit.

98362.text:
The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to the one who sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Turak Runetotem, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.

Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.
98362.todo: Return to Thunder Bluff and speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise.

98386.text:
Orcs, gnolls, murlocs. Everything seems to be out to stop me from getting this bridge done on time. Now we have word there's an infestation of tarantulas at our lumber mill!

If you're up to earn a bit more coin, would you head over to Alther's Mill to the east and clear out their spider problem? Place is as good as useless to me if I can't safely send workers to collect shipments.

Oh, and if you see ol' Alther, tell him he owes me for cleaning up his mess.
98386.todo: Slay 12 Greater Tarantulas and destroy 6 Tarantula Eggs in Alther's Mill for Foreman Oslow in Redridge.

98387.text:
You can't fight a war without weapons.

Though the Blackrock orcs have encroached upon these lands, their brazen efforts are not without certain vulnerabilities.

Head southeast below Stonewatch Keep, seek out their encampments, and target their weapons and supplies.

We'll see just how much of a threat they are without their tools of war.
98387.todo: Bring 8 Stolen Weapons and 10 Blackrock Supplies to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.

98389.text:
Greetings, <class>. Yes, I am a paladin. Not even death can stop the Light.

This is something my kind have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but I am not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.
98389.todo: Free 6 Webbed Victims in Night's Web Hollow for Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell.

98391.text:
Blessings to you, <class>. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.
98391.todo: Speak to Sister Aquinne in Darnassus.

98392.text:
These belts... look closely at the leather, <name>. Do you see the taint running through the fibers?

I have a suspicion as to its origin, but we will need further proof to be sure.

Venture back out into the harpies' nests to the west and take out their leaders. If their necklaces carry the same darkness as these belts, we'll have our answer.
98392.todo: Collect Hatescreech's Amulet, Windmistress Gaedress' Amulet, and Witchmother Arysa's Amulet for Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.

98393.text:
It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young druid. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
98393.todo: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

98394.text:
In the southern part of Moonglade, on a hill overlooking the bridge, resides a wise and cunning being we call the Great Cat Spirit.

Much like the Great Bear Spirit, this spirit has served as a tutor and mentor to druids that desire to take the feline shape. All druids eventually seek its wisdom, and if you desire to take the form of a cat, you will as well.

Go meet with the Great Cat Spirit and learn what it will teach you.
98394.todo: Seek out the Great Cat Spirit in southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the cat.

98396.text:
To draw upon my spirit, you will need more than a few words. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics of my favor you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me. We will see if you are ready to take my shape.
98396.todo: Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Great Cat Spirit.

98397.text:
The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to the one who sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.

Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.
98397.todo: Return to Darnassus and speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave.

98398.text:
I am impressed by what you have accomplished here in so short a time, <name>. Would that I could ask you to remain here to assist me with my duties... but I know in my heart that greater tasks lie ahead for you.

I have noticed the Oracle Tree has just shed a piece of its bark. No doubt it has a task that it wishes completed. You should speak with it.
98398.todo: Find the Oracle Tree Bark nearby to receive its message.

98403.text:
Lord Melenas did not act alone; he was at the behest of another. The one you seek is Xethorr the Wicked. It seems he has twisted the spiders that call Teldrassil home, intending their venom for some foul plan.

He has taken residence deep in the forest, in the area to the northwest of here known as the Cleft. Take caution, and bring allies, for Xethorr is not an opponent to be trifled with.

Dispatch his brood, and bring me anything that may tell us more of the satyr's work here.
98403.todo: Kill 8 Befouled Webwoods and bring Xethorr the Wicked's Mature Fel Moss to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.

98404.text:
In order to draw upon my spirit, you will need to undergo a trial. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me to pass the druidic trial of these lands.
98404.todo: Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Avatar of Saeyleenan.

98405.text:
In the southern part of Moonglade, on a hill overlooking the bridge, resides a wise and cunning being we call the Great Cat Spirit.

Much like the Great Bear Spirit, this spirit has served as a tutor and mentor to druids that desire to take the feline shape. All druids eventually seek its wisdom, and if you desire to take the form of a cat, you will as well.

Go meet with the Great Cat Spirit and learn what it will teach you.
98405.todo: Seek out the Great Cat Spirit in southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the cat.

98407.text:
If the gnolls are growing so bold they are willing to camp this close to humans, there's no telling how much further they'll go. We need to deter them.

The beasts are hardly organized, but they seem to respect strength above all else. If we can slay the worst of them, maybe claim some of their trophies, we can remind these gnolls why they should stay in the hills where they belong.

Should you see any of their thrashers, bring me their collars. That should put the fear of the Alliance back into them.
98407.todo: Collect 5 Spiked Collars from Redridge Thrashers for Deputy Feldon near Lakeshire.

98417.text:
At the moment our fates bound us most vulnerable, tragedy fell upon our villages. Satyrs defiled our temples, their profane touch staining sacred boughs, and they slaughtered the innocent without mercy.

Kurothel was consumed by wrath. The druids are taking the fight to the satyr, and he has followed.

Our bond endures. I feel my husband, west, within these woods. Please, return to me with news of his fate.
98417.todo: Maseara Autumnmoon wants you to search west of Forest Song, amongst the Satyrnaar demons. Report any signs of her husband Kurothel upon your return.

98418.text:
Kurothel mentioned sightings of what they say are wolf-men. Those of the pack now lurking in greater numbers in our forest. Last we had spoken, druids were pursuing communication with those of the beast heart who displayed measured control of their animal instincts.

His written words show a darker struggle. If there is anything we can do to help see HIM again, surely quelling the demon threat that is driving him to this burning transformation will be of aid to his anguished soul.

Slay the Xavian, <name>.
98418.todo:
Kill 5 Xavian Rogues, 5 Felsworn, 5 Betrayers, and 5 Hellcallers.
Return to Maseara Autumnmoon in Forest Song afterwards.

98423.text: Inside of the vault you find a tablet detailing the terms of a peace treaty between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarf clans. It appears to date back to time period just after the War of the Three Hammers, and is very likely a notable piece of dwarven history. The king of Ironforge would no doubt be interested in this artifact.
98423.todo: Deliver the Treaty of Understanding to Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.

98424.text:
Some particularly worn papers are held separately, folded in Fizsprocket's inside breast pocket.

They seem to detail important information that could be used against the Venture Co. and its operations in the region. It would be prudent to look for more before returning to Morin Cloudstalker.
98424.todo: Collect the rest of Supervisor Fizsprocket's pages inside The Venture Co. Mine and bring them to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.

98427.text:
The shredder one of the pages speaks of--I have seen them before in my travels. They can decimate a forest in a fraction of the time that hand and axe can.

Entire glades--homes to the Earth Mother's children for millennia--erased in days.

We will not allow this to happen in our home, a stone's throw from where our young ones take their first steps.

<name>, I must ask you to gather others, go back into the mine to the northeast, and ensure it fells not a single tree more.
98427.todo: Bring the Clearcutter Key to Morin Cloudstalker outside Bloodhoof Village.

98430.text:
Hail, <class>. What brings you deep into such a dark and violent place?

I was sent here by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof as a part of our efforts to communicate with the gnolls that have taken residence. The rest of my mission must remain a secret, as do all things with the Longwalkers, the trusted scouts of our chieftain.

All you must know is our diplomacy was met with violence, and I fear I may be tonight's feast for the gnolls if you do not help me escape.

Are you up to the task?
98430.todo: Help Perith Stormhoof escape Palemane Rock, and report his safety to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

98435.text:
Our elders in Thunder Bluff must know of the progress we have made here, thanks to your aid.

Please, take this to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. You will find him in the Elder Rise, on the east side of the city. You must take the lifts up to the center of the city, then cross the bridges to reach it.
98435.todo: Bring Thunderhorn's Report to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

98447.text:
Despite you putting down the Valor family ghosts, the reports of attacks have not ceased. It was a good gamble, but perhaps we did not settle their unfinished business after all.

From my research, it sounds like this family all went missing at the same time. Whatever trauma caused their spirits to be chained to this realm must have happened all at once.

Our only clue is where you found the book. Return to Raven Hill and see what you can find. Maybe bringing their weapons will spark something.
98447.todo: Find the cause of the Valor family ghosts in Raven Hill for Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.

98459.text:
Bart Tidewater's a no-good cheapskate, I tell ya!

"Captain of the Maiden's Virtue" he calls himself. That ship's sailed as far as a rock in Tanaris! He's no captain, he's an actor who won enough hands of poker to buy the Virtue in the first place!

If you ever find yourself in Menethil Harbor over in the Wetlands, give this to him and let him know it's from ol' Half-fish.

There's a boat from here that can take you right to the harbor, by the way. It'll be the second stop!

And he cheats at poker!
98459.todo: Deliver Tom's Gift to Bart Tidewater in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

98461.text:
If you're heading out of Auberdine, I could use your help!

My dear friend Tarrel and I were classmates in school. Oh, he was such a quickfire on all things excavation! We got split up after graduation--him to Wetlands, and me to here in Darkshore.

<Hollee sighs, then her brow furrows slightly.>

Sorry, and his wife... Merrin.

It doesn't matter. If you go to the Wetlands, could you make sure he's alright? And maybe give him this? He's probably near Menethil Harbor. There's a boat straight there.
98461.todo: Deliver Hollee's Note to Tarrel Rockweaver near Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

98463.text:
Look, I'm glad to have you at my bar, and that's exactly why I'm telling you this.

The real party? That's over at the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. Yes, in Stranglethorn Vale--that Booty Bay.

Don't give me that look. I know it's run by goblins. Bartenders talk, and bar patrons talk a LOT. All I'm saying is that if you want to see things get real wild, head over there.

Nixxrax Fillamug will keep you topped up, don't even worry.
98463.todo: Visit Nixxrax Fillamug in the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay in Stranglethorn.

98471.text:
Greetings, <name>.

I have an assignment for you that is of the utmost priority. Please meet me in the mountains called Alterac, northwest of the village known as Strahnbrad. I will meet you at the cliff overlooking the Uplands valley.

Come alone, and tell no one.
98471.todo: Meet Elaadrin Evengale at the cliffs overlooking The Uplands in Alterac Mountains.

98512.text:
You there, stranger. Get low and keep quiet. We are not alone here.

I was on patrol near the border and noticed that there are a number of Al'Aketh skulking around the house just up the hill there to the north. I don't know what they are doing here, but it can't be good.

If you want to make yourself useful, get in there and take them out. I'll wait here and watch your back.
98512.todo: Kill 10 Al'Aketh Assassins in the Shen'dar Highlands.

98517.text: Greetings, young Skyborne. The spirits have spoken of you, and tell me that you are ready to heed the call of fire. However, I shall not be the one to start you on that Path. Return to your home in the elemental plane, seek your mentors there. They will tell you what must be done.
98517.todo: Report to Sessaria Skystride or Aarnor Galestrike on Zephras Isle to continue your training as a Shaman.

98545.text:
Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the Undercity. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery.

You are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the Undercity. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time.

<Leonid lets out a low chuckle as he hands you the letter.>
98545.todo: Deliver the Sealed Letter to Glix Xizzix in the Undercity.

98574.text: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the priest trainer Branstock. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
98574.todo: Read the Hallowed Memorandum and speak to Branstock Khalder in Anvilmar.

98575.text:
Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, <name>.

I usually avoid dealing with warlocks if I can help it, but I think you should read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from your newly-appointed trainer, Nartok. He would have words with you when you're ready.
98575.todo: Read the Tainted Tablet and speak to Nartok inside the Den in the Valley of Trials.

98576.text:
Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, <name>.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.
98576.todo: Read the Glyphic Parchment and speak with Mai'ah near the entrance to the Den in the Valley of Trials.

98581.text: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. Based on the Wildhammer style to these inscriptions, I'm guessin' this came from the shaman trainer Teo Hammerstorm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
98581.todo: Read the Archaic Rune and speak to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.

98601.text:
While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine it's of some importance to a paladin like yourself.

Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.
98601.todo: Read the Consecrated Scroll and speak to Aramis Hammerhand in the church in Deathknell.

98731.text:
Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further. I do hope we meet again someday.

May the shadows forever hide you and your foes easily fall prey to your claws, young one.

98738.text:
Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further.

Unfortunately I have little left to teach you for the moment. I do hope you come and visit me in Zephras again someday. I sense promise in you, young shen'dorei.

May the shadows forever hide you, your foes easily fall prey to your claws, and the winds guide your steps.

98739.text:
Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further. I do hope we meet again someday.

May the shadows forever hide you and your foes easily fall prey to your claws, young one.

98815.text:
The Highlands are host to ruins of some sort, secrets now being explored by an expedition team. What I know is that they've got their own wildlife and beasts lurking in that mountain marshland. How about you take a foray in there with some well-equipped friends, and we work a trade?

I don't care if they're hiding, I want their hides! Bring me the skins from four of the Thicket Raptors, I'll have a trade worked out for you to make it worth it.
98815.todo: Return 4 Thicket Raptor Hides to James Halloran, the tanner, in Menethil Harbor.

98823.text:
Truly, this is a fascinating object.

It shows indications of being much more than a mere carving or sculpture.

While our elders may be interested in observing this artifact, the Earthen Ring are who would carry the most wisdom for our buried ruins and forgotten lands. Seek out Muln Earthfury, a direct approach is fitting for the gravity of what you carry.

You can find him and other elders of the Earthen Ring council at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.
98823.todo: Bring the Titan Relic to Muln Earthfury at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.

98824.text:
With titan-like inscriptions like that on its facets, nothing less than Ironforge's Hall of Explorers is the right place to bring it.

I'd like to think that you'll be noted in the history for it in the catalogue -- "Recovered by <name>! Authenticated by Prospector Whelgar..." Ah, I'm gettin' meself carried away.

High Explorer Magellas will receive you, and given the exquisite nature of what you carry, will surely be most generously appreciative should you donate it to the museum.

Good find!
98824.todo: Bring the Titan Relic to High Explorer Magellas in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers.

98887.text:
The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands.

Go, show them the might of the Horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
98887.todo: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

98888.text: The fight in Darkspear Islands is ceaseless, <name>. Together, we will destroy the Alliance dogs in the Theramore Expeditionary Force!

98889.text:
The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands.

Go, show them the might of the Horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
98889.todo: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

98891.text:
The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands.

Go, show them the might of the horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
98891.todo: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands.

Go, show them the might of the horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
98893.todo: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

98895.text:
The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us.

It is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
98895.todo: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

98896.text: The fight in the Darkspear Islands continues, <name>. Rally your forces and crush the Darkspear Raiders!

98897.text:
The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us.

It is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
98897.todo: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

It is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
98899.todo: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

It is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
98901.todo: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

98903.text: Go forth and represent the Theramore Expeditionary Force in battle at Darkspear Islands, <name>! Achieve victory and show these Horde dogs the might of the Alliance!
98903.todo: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Brelinda McFarry at Northwatch Hold.

98904.text: Go forth and represent the Theramore Expeditionary Force in battle at Darkspear Islands, <name>! Achieve victory and show these Horde dogs the might of the Alliance!
98904.todo: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Brelinda McFarry at Northwatch Hold.

98905.text: Go forth and represent the Theramore Expeditionary Force in battle at Darkspear Islands, <name>! Achieve victory and show these Horde dogs the might of the Alliance!
98905.todo: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Brelinda McFarry at Northwatch Hold.

98906.text:
The battle at the Darkspear Islands be locked in a stalemate, <class>. Show those Alliance fools who the superior force is.

Carry your head high in service of the Darkspear and claim victory in battle. The Loa will surely be givin' you their blessing, <class>!
98906.todo: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Nizook Boof at The Merchant Coast.

98907.text: The battle at the Darkspear Islands be locked in a stalemate, <class>. Show those Alliance fools who the superior force is. Carry your head high in service of the Darkspear and claim victory in battle. The Loa will surely be givin' you their blessing, <class>!
98907.todo: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Nizook Boof at The Merchant Coast.

98908.text:
The battle at the Darkspear Islands be locked in a stalemate, <class>. Show those Alliance fools who the superior force is.

Carry your head high in service of the Darkspear and claim victory in battle. The Loa will surely be givin' you their blessing, <class>!
98908.todo: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Nizook Boof at The Merchant Coast.

99046.text:
The Council of the Forest sent a small group of sentinels to the Oracle Tree some time ago. The tree sends messages to our elders, and it falls to us to deliver them to Darnassus safely.

I received word that our most recent runner has not yet arrived. The Oracle's messages vary in frequency, but it has been abnormally long.

Please head towards the Oracle Glade along the road to the west and check on her. It would have been Eralya Leafshadow's turn, and she is still in training. Elune guide you.
99046.todo: Search for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow on the road leading to the Oracle Glade.

99047.text:
My sisters and I... were dispatched... Oracle Tree...

Tree... message. I... harpies... everywhere...

<Eralya coughs up blood, grimacing through the pain.>

I may not have long... no one coming. Please... Byancie... in Dolanaar...
99047.todo: Seek aid from Byancie in Dolanaar for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow.

99048.text:
A member of the Shattered Hand, a group of more... subtle fighters, was watching Tiragarde Keep from a distance. Her reports suddenly stopped coming in.

I doubt the humans would have caught her, so I'm concerned something more dangerous is at play. See if you can find her. Hopefully the messages are just delayed.
99048.todo: Find Heglan Shadeeye north of Tiragarde Keep.

99049.text:
The nearby area is destroyed with obvious signs of a skirmish. Whatever ambushed Heglan didn't make it out unscathed. There's probably signs nearby of what happened.

Orgnil will probably want to see any evidence left by the attackers.
99049.todo: Find signs of what attacked Heglan Shadeeye.

99050.text:
I will need your help acquiring the ingredients I need to stop the affliction long enough for Eralya to make it back here for further treatment.

Thankfully, our living home is still bountiful and will provide in our time of need.

The core ingredient is dewy lasher fronds. You'll find them around Lake Al'Ameth directly south of here, or Wellspring Lake and its river to the northwest.

In addition, I'll need an empty vial and some spring water. Both can be bought here in town, or traded for.
99050.todo: Collect 6 Dewy Lasher Fronds, an Empty Vial, and a Refreshing Spring Water for Byancie in Dolanaar.

99051.text:
It wouldn't be the first time those snakes bothered us. They need to be taught that their presence is not tolerated here.

Find where their scouts are setting up camp and slaughter them. Bring me back their fins as proof. We need to act fast to make sure they understand.

99052.text:
One of my scouts has reported a sea giant followed those naga down here. Not sure if they brought him intentionally or what, but he's dangerous in any case.

It's a young one, but it could still rip an orc in half in a heartbeat if they were caught off guard. I need him gone. But I'd suggest you find some help to deal with it.
99052.todo: Kill the sea giant along Durotar's north coast and bring back proof of your accomplishment.

99053.text:
My prayers have been answered! I am thankful that you have fought your way down here.

I was sent here by the Oracle Tree to deliver a message to the slumbering druids here only to find it completely overrun by furbolg! They ambushed me before I could turn back and brought me down here--I fear for their next meal.

I don't know about you, but I loathe this place. Under the earth is no place for the kaldorei.
99053.todo: Help Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom escape Ban'ethil Barrow Den, and report her safety to Sentinel Kyra Starsong in Dolanaar.

99073.text:
The salve is ready. Take it to Eralya swiftly.

I do not know if it will truly cure her. The rot festers quickly, and grows in strength as it spreads.

It will, if nothing else, ease her suffering. And that is still worth your haste.
99073.todo: Take the Lashwater Salve to Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow on the road to the Oracle Tree.

99079.text:
The Longwalkers are our people's most trusted scouts. Though their loyalty lies with the High Chieftain alone, young Baine at times seeks their aid.

This is one such time. Longwalker Malah was dispatched near our borders to the east and did not return last night after three days. When this occurs, it is our duty to confirm their safety.

I must ensure the village remains safe. Prove yourself, and seek Malah out. You will know her by her headband and feathered staff, emblematic of the Longwalkers.
99079.todo: Find Longwalker Malah Longwind east of Bloodhoof Village, near the edge of Mulgore.

99080.text:
Hear my words well: we will not yield a single blade of grass to the centaur.

Go to their camp now, before they have rested and have a chance to ride to our village. Slaughter them all. Ensure none escape to the Barrens to rally others to their aid.

If you find the leader of this would-be raiding party, bring me his head so that it may serve as a warning to others who dare tread on our ancestral homeland.
99080.todo: Kill 6 Galak Centaurs, 4 Galak Outrunners, and bring the head of Herak the Pillager to Baine Bloodhoof.

99081.text:
You can see what appears to be a new centaur camp in the direction the arrows in Malah's back would have come from. There is a stir of activity, suggesting a small raiding party has made its way into Mulgore.

The Longwalker has a report in her still-clenched hand. Brave Wildrunner will want to know of Malah's fate--and her killers.
99081.todo: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Brave Wildrunner in Bloodhoof Village.

99082.text:
Your bravery defending your people demands recognition. Journey to Thunder Bluff to the northwest, our mighty city whose shadow grants us shade in the warmer months, and seek audience with my father.

It was he who led the charge with the young Warchief Thrall to reclaim these plains and drive the centaur away for good. As High Chieftain, he will reward you generously for your part in ensuring his own bravery is honored.

You must take a lift to reach the High Chieftain, who sits on the central rise.
99082.todo: Seek audience with High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

99101.text:
Baine Bloodhoof leads our village. He must know of this incursion at once.

Bring him Longwalker Malah's report. You will find him at the center of town.

Quickly, now. There is no time to waste!
99101.todo: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Baine Bloodhoof.

99108.text:
Hail, young <class>. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
99108.todo: Defeat 3 other players in duels or Novice Warriors for Tang Stonehoof.

99123.text:
I decided to do a bit of scouting in the crag on my own. Unfortunately my magic ran out at the wrong time and I've been stuck hiding here since.

If you could help me escape, I would appreciate it.
99123.todo: Help Pal'juh escape Kolkar Crag and bring news of your success to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.

99127.text:
The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all.

Lee here set up some traps overnight. Go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.
99127.todo: Check the fishing traps in Crystal Lake.

99128.text:
This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match.

If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.
99128.todo: Kill the murlocs at Crystal Lake.

99129.text:
Remy mentioned murlocs the other day... I'm pretty sure he hates the little buggers as much as I do.

He might have some ideas on how to keep them away from my fish in the future. I'd like to ask you to go chat with him and see if there's anything he can think of.
99129.todo: Speak with Remy "Two Times" about Jason's murloc problems.

99130.text:
I've got a few ideas on how to deal with murlocs. And one of those also helps some others in the process.

There's a weed often found on farms in the area called duskweed, and in large quantities the petals are toxic to most animals. If we make some murloc bait with the plant, hopefully that can train those creatures to stay away.

And some farmers get their fields cleared in the process. Truly a win-win... truly a win-win.

99131.text:
Tell Mathers he can come pick up the bait later today. I'll give him the rundown on the proper usage.

Hopefully he'll be able to sell his fish again soon. And we'll have less murlocs in this world.

99134.text:
You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me.

As a reward for your relative lack of incompetence, you shall punish those that have demonstrated such talents in excess.

Swiftly now--<name>, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.

99141.text:
Make no mistake, <class>--the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens.

Reports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name.

You will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.
99141.todo: Obtain reports from Deathguard Dillinger, Deathguard Kristof, and Gordo for Executor Zygand.

99142.text:
If you're heading east, towards the Balnir Farmstead, I have more you might do for me. Good help is ever so hard to find these days, as your run-in with Gordo illuminates ever so clearly.

As I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.

Do keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... drawn... to the weed. Curious.
99142.todo: Collect 5 Tomb Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.

99143.text:
Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like!

If you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.
99143.todo: Collect 6 pieces of shiny junk from the nearby Murloc camp.

99144.text:
Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... all I strive to protect!

<Bareth Dawnstone steadies himself.>

I know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.
99144.todo: Help Bareth Dawnstone escape Crusader's Outpost, and report his safety to Shari Stilwell in Brill.

99152.text:
While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep.

I need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course.

Travel beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.
99152.todo: Collect 6 Faintly Glowing Bones for Hilda the Breaker.

99153.text:
Oi, you! Word travels quickly among our ranks. I heard about the work you did with the cultists around the remnants of the battle with Naxxramas.

Problem is, one of them cultists got away with a piece of the focusing crystal. Seems to still have some juice in it. Best guess we have is it's somewhere beneath Shadowvale. It's either raising 'em or making 'em stronger, and you don't want either one.

Find that crystal before this gets out of hand.
99153.todo: Find the Hidden Crystal Fragment beneath Shadowvale for Ephram Barbaro.

99156.text:
Damn it all! A new report came in while you were on patrol. There has been a sighting of a rogue abomination wandering Eastern Tirisfal Glades, near Venomweb Vale.

Something is wrong. Abominations don't just slip through the Bulwark unnoticed.

Keep this matter on a strictly need-to-know basis. That said, such a creature will not fall easily; you will need allies if you wish to be more than its next meal.

See this through, and you will be duly rewarded. Bring me its heart as proof of the deed.
99156.todo: Bring Riptear's Heart to Deathguard Linnea.

99158.text:
There's a priest out in the mountains that belongs to an organization called the Argent Dawn. They're a holy group that is dedicated to finding and destroying the unholy and unnatural.

Father Gavin though, he's mostly the type that seeks to help and heal everyone rather than grab a weapon. He's fixed up an old building to serve as a rest spot for travelers and called it Misty Pine Refuge. I've got a shipment of holy candles that I need to get him. Could you bring them to him if you're going that way?
99158.todo: Bring the crate of candles to Father Gavin at Misty Pine Refuge.

99159.text:
My hearth is open to warm any soul, but I'd like to ask you to help me if you could.

I simply need more firewood. It is something I would normally do myself, but I have been preoccupied by other tasks.

99160.text:
You may have noticed the elementals nearby. A shelf of rock and ice fell from the mountain peaks a few days ago and riled them up.

These frozen mountains are already treacherous for the average dwarf or human without the elements taking form. I am not one for fighting anymore--so any of the spirits you can kill would help make the road safer.

99161.text:
I noticed that the first elemental that appeared after the rockslide was larger than its peers. And from what I can tell, it has been the source of occasional weather changes and other minor slides.

I've been calling it 'Avala', if you could kill it and retrieve the core as proof, I will reward you.
99161.todo: Kill Avala and retrieve its core.

99162.text:
Even mountaineers from Ironforge have to keep their wits about them when traversing through the peaks of Dun Morogh. Falling snow and ice often spells the end of some more novice members' lives.

After a slide, I usually try to find any sign of survivors or victims--while praying to the Light that there's nothing to be found. But with the elements acting up, I've held off wandering too far. If you could look for some lost mountaineers and bring me their rifles, I will return them to Ironforge.
99162.todo: Collect the rifles of fallen mountaineers.

99191.text:
The High Order are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the High Order for your generous actions. Sixty pieces of wool should prove to be a sufficient amount for the High Order's needs for now.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

99260.text:
I was tasked to retrieve important data on the flow of elemental energy from the Overlook Standing Stones. That data is vital to our plans to safely travel between Skywall and Azeroth. Without that data to aid in our calculations, our attempts to steer our skycutter ships through the elemental plane will fail.

The data is likely lost at this point, and I'm in no state to attempt to gather it again. I told the Supreme Magister of your role in saving me, and he wishes to speak with you again.
99260.todo: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar.

99267.text:
The deceased Night Watchman lying before you is covered in deep gashes and cuts. It's clear to see that he was mauled by some sort of large beast.

You notice that the corpse still has an unlit torch in his hand. You must not have taken it earlier after all.

You reach down and pry it from his stiff fingers. This could be useful in your travels through Duskwood and beyond to reveal things hidden by darkness.

99411.text:
Help, <name>! My prized puppy, Kyle, has run away! I just know he's running around Bloodhoof Village, lost and hungry.

Will you find him and feed him? Once he eats he will settle down and come home.

To feed him you will need to find food. His favorite meal is tender strider meat. Just venture east and you should find plenty of striders. Hunt one down and take its succulent meat to Kyle. When you see Kyle in town, put the meat down and he is sure to come to you.
